abroad.usageZh: 副词，表示“在国外，到国外”。常放在动词后，如 go abroad（出国）、study abroad（留学）、live abroad（在国外生活）。口语和书面语都常用。

family.meaning: 海外；国外（罕见，多用于固定短语）

examples.sentence: My uncle works abroad and sends us postcards.
examples.trans: 我叔叔在国外工作，给我们寄明信片。

examples.sentence: She has never been abroad, but she dreams of visiting Paris.
examples.trans: 她从未出过国，但她梦想去巴黎。

examples.sentence: Many students choose to study abroad after they finish high school.
examples.trans: 许多学生选择在高中毕业后出国留学。

examples.sentence: Having lived abroad for several years, he now understands how culture shapes daily habits.
examples.trans: 在国外生活了几年之后，他现在明白了文化如何塑造日常习惯。

examples.sentence: While working abroad can be rewarding, it often comes with a deep sense of homesickness.
examples.trans: 虽然在国外工作可能很有收获，但它往往伴随着深深的思乡之情。

examples.sentence: The decision to settle abroad permanently is rarely made without weighing both professional opportunities and family ties.
examples.trans: 决定永久定居国外，很少是在没有权衡职业机会和家庭纽带的情况下做出的。

popular.usageZh: 形容词，表示“受欢迎的，流行的”。常用搭配：be popular with/among（受……欢迎）、a popular choice（热门选择）、popular culture（流行文化）。口语和书面语都常用。

examples.sentence: This game is very popular in our class.
examples.trans: 这个游戏在我们班很受欢迎。

examples.sentence: The new restaurant is popular with families because it has a kids' menu.
examples.trans: 这家新餐厅很受家庭欢迎，因为它有儿童菜单。

examples.sentence: Basketball has become increasingly popular among teenagers in recent years.
examples.trans: 近年来，篮球在青少年中变得越来越受欢迎。

examples.sentence: The idea of learning a second language through apps has grown popular among busy professionals.
examples.trans: 通过应用程序学习第二语言的想法在忙碌的职场人士中变得流行起来。

examples.sentence: Contrary to popular belief, not all teenagers prefer online communication over face-to-face interaction.
examples.trans: 与普遍看法相反，并非所有青少年都喜欢线上交流胜过面对面互动。

examples.sentence: The once popular theory has been largely abandoned in light of recent experimental evidence.
examples.trans: 鉴于最近的实验证据，这个曾经流行的理论已在很大程度上被抛弃。

view.usageZh: 名词，表示“观点，看法”或“景色”。常用短语：in my view（在我看来）、point of view（观点）、a view of（……的景色）。也可作动词，表示“看待，考虑”。

examples.sentence: Our hotel room has a nice view of the sea.
examples.trans: 我们的酒店房间能看到美丽的海景。

examples.sentence: In my view, reading is more fun than watching TV.
examples.trans: 在我看来，阅读比看电视更有趣。

examples.sentence: From the top of the hill, you can enjoy a wonderful view of the whole village.
examples.trans: 从山顶上，你可以欣赏到整个村庄的美景。

examples.sentence: Her view on education has changed significantly since she started teaching abroad.
examples.trans: 自从她开始在国外教书以来，她对教育的看法发生了显著变化。

examples.sentence: The two scholars hold sharply contrasting views on how to interpret the historical data.
examples.trans: 这两位学者对如何解读历史数据持有截然不同的观点。

examples.sentence: A balanced view of technological progress acknowledges both its transformative benefits and its unintended social costs.
examples.trans: 对技术进步的平衡看法既承认其变革性的好处，也承认其意想不到的社会代价。

refresh.usageZh: 及物动词，意为“使恢复精力，使振作”。常见搭配：refresh your mind/brain（提神醒脑）、refresh yourself（让自己恢复精神）、refresh one's memory（唤起记忆）。口语和书面语均可使用，常与 a short break、a cold drink、a walk 等搭配。

family.meaning: 令人精神焕发的，清爽的
恢复精神的，精神振作的

examples.sentence: A cold shower can refresh you on a hot day.
examples.trans: 大热天洗个冷水澡能让你精神起来。

examples.sentence: I drank some water to refresh myself after the basketball game.
examples.trans: 篮球比赛后，我喝了点水让自己恢复精神。

examples.sentence: If you feel sleepy in the afternoon, a short nap can refresh your brain.
examples.trans: 如果你下午觉得困，小睡一会儿可以让大脑恢复清醒。

examples.sentence: Taking a few deep breaths before the exam helped refresh my mind and calm my nerves.
examples.trans: 考试前做几次深呼吸帮助我提神醒脑，也让我平静下来。

examples.sentence: Rather than forcing yourself to keep working, stepping outside for ten minutes will refresh your focus far more effectively.
examples.trans: 与其强迫自己继续工作，不如出去走十分钟，这能更有效地恢复你的专注力。

examples.sentence: A brief change of environment, even something as simple as rearranging your desk, can refresh your perspective on a problem you have been stuck on for hours.
examples.trans: 短暂地换个环境，哪怕只是重新整理一下书桌，也能让你对纠结了好几个小时的问题产生新的视角。

relatives.usageZh: 名词，复数形式，单数为 relative，意为“亲戚，亲属”。指家庭成员，如父母、兄弟姐妹、叔叔阿姨、堂表亲等。常见搭配：visit relatives（走亲戚）、close relatives（近亲）、distant relatives（远亲）。

examples.sentence: My relatives often come to my home on Sundays.
examples.trans: 我的亲戚们经常周日来我家。

examples.sentence: We are going to visit our relatives in the countryside this weekend.
examples.trans: 这个周末我们打算去乡下看望亲戚。

examples.sentence: During the Spring Festival, people usually get together with their relatives and enjoy a big dinner.
examples.trans: 春节期间，人们通常和亲戚团聚，享用丰盛的晚餐。

examples.sentence: Although my relatives live in different cities, we keep in touch through video calls every month.
examples.trans: 虽然我的亲戚们住在不同的城市，但我们每个月通过视频通话保持联系。

examples.sentence: Unlike close friends, relatives are connected by blood, which means the bond often remains even when contact becomes rare.
examples.trans: 与亲密朋友不同，亲戚之间由血缘相连，这意味着即使联系变少，纽带往往依然存在。

examples.sentence: When she moved abroad for work, she made a point of calling her elderly relatives every week, aware that such small gestures meant more to them than any gift.
examples.trans: 当她出国工作时，她坚持每周给年长的亲戚打电话，因为她明白这样的小举动对他们来说比任何礼物都更有意义。

culture.usageZh: 名词，可数或不可数，意为“文化”。指一个民族或群体的风俗、艺术、制度及成就。常见搭配：local culture（当地文化）、traditional culture（传统文化）、culture shock（文化冲击）、cultural differences（文化差异）。

examples.sentence: Chinese culture has a very long history.
examples.trans: 中国文化有着非常悠久的历史。

examples.sentence: We learned about the food culture of different countries in class.
examples.trans: 我们在课堂上了解了不同国家的饮食文化。

examples.sentence: Learning a new language also helps you understand a new culture better.
examples.trans: 学习一门新语言也能帮助你更好地理解一种新文化。

examples.sentence: Traveling to different regions allows you to experience local culture through food, festivals, and daily customs.
examples.trans: 到不同地区旅行能让你通过食物、节日和日常习俗体验当地文化。

examples.sentence: What is considered polite in one culture may be seen as rude in another, which is why cross-cultural awareness is essential in international business.
examples.trans: 在一种文化中被视为礼貌的行为，在另一种文化中可能被认为是粗鲁的，这就是为什么跨文化意识在国际商务中至关重要。

examples.sentence: As globalization accelerates, preserving local culture has become a pressing concern, since unique traditions can easily be diluted by the spread of a dominant global culture.
examples.trans: 随着全球化加速，保护地方文化已成为一个紧迫的问题，因为独特的传统很容易被占主导地位的全球文化所稀释。

complain.usageZh: 动词，意为“抱怨，发牢骚”。最常用结构是 complain about sth（抱怨某事）和 complain that...（抱怨说……）。口语和书面语都常见，但注意不要漏掉介词 about。

examples.sentence: My little brother always complains about the food at dinner.
examples.trans: 我弟弟总是在晚饭时抱怨食物。

examples.sentence: She complained to the teacher that the test was too hard.
examples.trans: 她向老师抱怨说考试太难了。

examples.sentence: Instead of complaining about the noise, he put on his earphones and kept working.
examples.trans: 他没有抱怨噪音，而是戴上耳机继续工作。

examples.sentence: Several customers have complained that the new online payment system often fails without any warning.
examples.trans: 好几位顾客抱怨说新的在线支付系统经常毫无预警地出故障。

examples.sentence: Rather than complaining about the lack of resources, the team chose to redesign the project around what they actually had.
examples.trans: 团队没有抱怨资源不足，而是选择围绕实际拥有的条件重新设计项目。

examples.sentence: While residents continue to complain about the delayed subway extension, officials insist that the revised schedule will be published before the end of the month.
examples.trans: 尽管居民们仍在抱怨地铁延长线延期，官员们坚称修订后的时间表将在月底前公布。

seaside.usageZh: 名词，意为“海边，海滨”。常作定语修饰名词，如 seaside town（海滨小镇）、seaside resort（海滨度假地）。多用于描述度假、休闲场景，英式英语中尤其常见。

examples.sentence: We bought ice cream at a small shop near the seaside.
examples.trans: 我们在海边附近的一家小店买了冰淇淋。

examples.sentence: My grandparents moved to a quiet seaside town after they retired.
examples.trans: 我祖父母退休后搬到了一个安静的海滨小镇。

examples.sentence: The seaside path is lovely in the early morning, before the tourists arrive.
examples.trans: 清晨游客到来之前，海边小路非常美。

examples.sentence: Having grown up in a busy city, she found the slow rhythm of seaside life both strange and comforting.
examples.trans: 在繁忙城市长大的她，觉得海边生活的缓慢节奏既陌生又令人安心。

examples.sentence: The old seaside hotel, once crowded with summer visitors, now stands empty for most of the year.
examples.trans: 那家老海滨旅馆曾经挤满夏季游客，如今一年中大部分时间都空着。

examples.sentence: Local authorities argue that protecting the seaside ecosystem must take priority over expanding tourist facilities, even at the cost of short-term revenue.
examples.trans: 当地政府认为，保护海滨生态系统必须优先于扩建旅游设施，即使以牺牲短期收入为代价。

recommendations.usageZh: 名词，是 recommendation 的复数形式，意为“推荐，建议”。常用搭配：give/make recommendations（提出建议）、follow sb's recommendations（听从某人的建议）、based on recommendations（根据建议）。比 advice 更正式，常见于报告、评审或服务场景。

examples.sentence: My friend gave me some good recommendations for new songs.
examples.trans: 我朋友给我推荐了一些好听的新歌。

examples.sentence: The doctor's recommendations included drinking more water and sleeping earlier.
examples.trans: 医生的建议包括多喝水和早睡觉。

examples.sentence: After reading the reviews, I followed her recommendations and bought the blue backpack.
examples.trans: 看完评价后，我听从她的推荐买了那个蓝色背包。

examples.sentence: The committee will publish its final recommendations on school lunch standards next week.
examples.trans: 委员会将于下周公布关于学校午餐标准的最终建议。

examples.sentence: His recommendations, though practical and well supported by data, were largely ignored by the board.
examples.trans: 他的建议虽然切实可行且有充分数据支持，却在很大程度上被董事会忽视了。

examples.sentence: The report concludes that without clear policy recommendations backed by reliable evidence, public trust in the reform process will continue to decline.
examples.trans: 报告总结说，如果没有可靠证据支撑的明确政策建议，公众对改革进程的信任将继续下降。

traditions.usageZh: 名词，复数形式，单数为 tradition。常与 culture、family、local、old 等词搭配，表示长期流传下来的习俗、观念或做法。口语和书面语都常用，尤其在谈论节日、家庭或文化话题时。

examples.sentence: My family has a tradition of eating dumplings on Sunday.
examples.trans: 我们家有个传统，星期天吃饺子。

examples.sentence: Different countries have different New Year traditions.
examples.trans: 不同的国家有不同的新年传统。

examples.sentence: Although we live in a modern city, we still keep many old family traditions.
examples.trans: 虽然我们住在现代城市，但我们仍然保留着许多古老的家庭传统。

examples.sentence: Passing down traditions from one generation to the next helps keep a culture alive.
examples.trans: 把传统一代一代传下去有助于保持一种文化的活力。

examples.sentence: Unlike written laws, many social traditions are learned through daily life rather than formal teaching.
examples.trans: 与成文法律不同，许多社会传统是通过日常生活而不是正式教学习得的。

examples.sentence: While some traditions strengthen community bonds, others may fade away when they no longer fit the way people live.
examples.trans: 虽然有些传统能加强社区纽带，但另一些传统在不再适合人们的生活方式时可能会逐渐消失。

routine.usageZh: 名词，表示日常固定的一套做法或顺序。常见搭配有 daily routine、morning routine、break the routine。可作可数名词，也可作不可数名词使用。口语和书面语都常见，尤其在谈论学习、工作或生活习惯时。

examples.sentence: My morning routine is simple: get up, wash my face, and eat breakfast.
examples.trans: 我的晨间常规很简单：起床、洗脸、吃早餐。

examples.sentence: After school, I follow the same routine every day: do homework, read, and then sleep.
examples.trans: 放学后，我每天遵循同样的常规：做作业、阅读，然后睡觉。

examples.sentence: Once you have a good study routine, you will find it easier to finish your tasks on time.
examples.trans: 一旦你有了良好的学习常规，你就会发现更容易按时完成任务。

examples.sentence: Having a regular exercise routine can improve both your physical health and your mood.
examples.trans: 有规律的锻炼习惯可以改善你的身体健康和情绪。

examples.sentence: Although routines can make life more efficient, an overly fixed schedule may leave little room for creativity.
examples.trans: 虽然常规能让生活更高效，但过于固定的日程可能会给创造力留下很少的空间。

examples.sentence: The researcher found that children who followed a consistent bedtime routine tended to sleep longer and wake up less during the night.
examples.trans: 研究人员发现，遵循固定就寝常规的儿童往往睡眠时间更长，夜间醒来的次数也更少。

memories.usageZh: 名词，复数形式，单数为 memory。常与 happy、childhood、sweet、bitter 等形容词搭配，也可与 create、bring back、cherish 等动词搭配。口语中常说 good memories、old memories，书面语中也可用于较正式的回忆叙述。

examples.sentence: I have many happy memories of playing with my dog.
examples.trans: 我有很多和我的狗一起玩耍的快乐回忆。

examples.sentence: Looking at old photos always brings back sweet memories of my childhood.
examples.trans: 看老照片总是能带回我童年的甜蜜回忆。

examples.sentence: The school trip left us with so many wonderful memories that we still talk about it today.
examples.trans: 那次学校旅行给我们留下了许多美好的回忆，直到今天我们还在谈论它。

examples.sentence: Keeping a diary is a good way to preserve memories that might otherwise fade over time.
examples.trans: 写日记是保存那些否则可能随着时间褪色的记忆的好方法。

examples.sentence: What we call memories are not exact recordings of the past but rather reconstructions shaped by our present feelings.
examples.trans: 我们所谓的记忆并不是对过去的精确记录，而是由我们当前感受塑造的重构。

examples.sentence: Studies suggest that emotionally intense events tend to form stronger and more lasting memories than ordinary daily experiences.
examples.trans: 研究表明，情绪强烈的事件往往比普通的日常经历形成更牢固、更持久的记忆。

destinations.usageZh: 名词，复数形式，单数为 destination。常见搭配：tourist destination（旅游目的地）、final destination（最终目的地）、popular destination（热门目的地）。可用于描述旅行计划、物流运输或人生目标。

examples.sentence: The bus stops at three destinations before the zoo.
examples.trans: 这辆公交车在到达动物园之前停靠三个目的地。

examples.sentence: We wrote down the names of all the destinations on our travel list.
examples.trans: 我们把旅行清单上所有目的地的名字都写了下来。

examples.sentence: Before you book the train tickets, make sure you know the arrival times for both destinations.
examples.trans: 在你订火车票之前，确保你知道两个目的地的到达时间。

examples.sentence: Having explored most of Asia, she is now looking for less crowded destinations in South America.
examples.trans: 在游历了亚洲大部分地区之后，她现在正在寻找南美洲不那么拥挤的目的地。

examples.sentence: Unlike popular beach resorts, remote mountain destinations often offer travelers a rare sense of stillness and isolation.
examples.trans: 与热门海滩度假地不同，偏远的山区目的地往往给旅行者带来一种难得的宁静与隔绝感。

examples.sentence: The survey revealed that while price remains a decisive factor, an increasing number of young travelers prioritize destinations with strong cultural identities over those offering mere luxury.
examples.trans: 调查显示，尽管价格仍是决定性因素，但越来越多的年轻旅行者优先选择具有强烈文化特色的目的地，而非仅仅提供奢华体验的地方。

magnificent.usageZh: 形容词，用于描述景色、建筑、艺术品或经历极其壮丽、宏伟或出色。常见搭配：magnificent view（壮丽的景色）、magnificent palace（宏伟的宫殿）、magnificent performance（精彩的表演）。语气比 beautiful 更强。

examples.sentence: We saw a magnificent rainbow after the rain.
examples.trans: 雨后我们看到了一道壮丽的彩虹。

examples.sentence: The king lived in a magnificent palace with golden doors.
examples.trans: 国王住在一座有金色大门的宏伟宫殿里。

examples.sentence: The view from the top of the hill was so magnificent that we forgot how tired we were.
examples.trans: 山顶的景色如此壮丽，以至于我们忘记了自己有多累。

examples.sentence: Standing before the magnificent cathedral, the travelers were struck by the skill of the medieval builders.
examples.trans: 站在这座宏伟的大教堂前，旅行者们被中世纪建造者的技艺深深震撼。

examples.sentence: The orchestra delivered a magnificent performance, yet the audience's applause seemed strangely subdued.
examples.trans: 管弦乐队奉献了一场精彩的演出，然而观众的掌声却出奇地克制。

examples.sentence: What makes the ancient temple truly magnificent is not its size but the precision with which every stone was carved and placed centuries ago.
examples.trans: 这座古庙真正令人赞叹的并非其规模，而是几个世纪前每一块石头被雕刻和安放时所展现的精确。

frequently.usageZh: 副词，意为“频繁地，经常地”，通常放在实义动词之前、be 动词或助动词之后，也可置于句末。常见搭配：frequently asked questions（常见问题）、occur frequently（频繁发生）。

examples.sentence: My cat frequently sleeps on my bed.
examples.trans: 我的猫经常睡在我的床上。

examples.sentence: She frequently visits her grandparents on weekends.
examples.trans: 她经常在周末去看望她的祖父母。

examples.sentence: If you frequently forget your homework, your teacher will start to worry about your study habits.
examples.trans: 如果你经常忘记写作业，你的老师会开始担心你的学习习惯。

examples.sentence: Students who frequently participate in class discussions tend to develop stronger critical thinking skills.
examples.trans: 经常参与课堂讨论的学生往往能培养出更强的批判性思维能力。

examples.sentence: Although the old bridge is frequently closed for repairs, local residents still consider it the most convenient route into town.
examples.trans: 尽管这座老桥经常因维修而关闭，当地居民仍认为它是进城最方便的路线。

examples.sentence: Researchers have found that individuals who frequently switch between multiple tasks show a measurable decline in their ability to sustain focused attention.
examples.trans: 研究人员发现，经常在多项任务之间切换的人，其保持专注注意力的能力会出现可测量的下降。

crowds.usageZh: 名词，复数形式，单数为 crowd。表示“人群”，强调数量多、聚集在一起的人。常用搭配：crowds of people（成群的人）、avoid the crowds（避开人群）、join the crowds（加入人群）。口语和书面语均可使用。

examples.sentence: There were big crowds at the park on Sunday.
examples.trans: 星期天公园里有很多人。

examples.sentence: Crowds of students waited outside the school gate before it opened.
examples.trans: 校门打开前，成群的学生在外面等候。

examples.sentence: If you want to avoid the crowds, you should visit the museum on a weekday morning.
examples.trans: 如果你想避开人群，应该在工作日的上午去参观博物馆。

examples.sentence: The streets were filled with crowds celebrating the team's victory, waving flags and singing loudly.
examples.trans: 街道上挤满了庆祝球队胜利的人群，他们挥舞旗帜，高声歌唱。

examples.sentence: Rather than joining the crowds at popular tourist spots, we explored the quiet back streets of the old town.
examples.trans: 我们没有去热门景点凑热闹，而是探索了老城区安静的小巷。

examples.sentence: Despite the heavy rain, enormous crowds gathered in the square, determined to witness the historic moment.
examples.trans: 尽管下着大雨，仍有大量人群聚集在广场上，决心见证这一历史性时刻。

queues.usageZh: 名词，复数形式，单数为 queue（英式）或 line（美式）。表示“队列、长队”，指排队等候的人或车辆。常用搭配：long queues（长队）、stand in a queue（排队等候）、join the queue（加入队列）。英式英语中更常用 queue。

examples.sentence: There were long queues at the ice cream shop.
examples.trans: 冰淇淋店前排了很长的队。

examples.sentence: We stood in queues for almost an hour to get our lunch.
examples.trans: 我们排了将近一个小时的队才买到午餐。

examples.sentence: The queues for the new roller coaster were so long that we decided to come back later.
examples.trans: 新过山车的队伍太长了，我们决定晚点再来。

examples.sentence: Having noticed the queues stretching around the block, we realized the exhibition was far more popular than expected.
examples.trans: 看到队伍排到了街区拐角，我们意识到这个展览比预想的要受欢迎得多。

examples.sentence: Unlike the chaotic queues at the ticket office, the online booking system allowed us to reserve seats within minutes.
examples.trans: 与售票处混乱的排队不同，在线订票系统让我们几分钟内就订好了座位。

examples.sentence: Long queues outside grocery stores became a common sight during the shortage, as residents rushed to stock up on daily necessities.
examples.trans: 物资短缺期间，杂货店外排起长队成了常见景象，居民们争相囤积日常必需品。

reduce.usageZh: 及物动词，表示“减少、降低”，指使数量、程度、规模等变小。常用搭配：reduce the risk/cost/number（降低风险/成本/数量）、reduce pollution（减少污染）、reduce stress（减轻压力）。也可用于被动语态 be reduced to（被减少到）。

examples.sentence: We should reduce the time we spend on video games.
examples.trans: 我们应该减少花在电子游戏上的时间。

examples.sentence: Eating less sugar can help reduce the risk of getting sick.
examples.trans: 少吃糖有助于降低生病的风险。

examples.sentence: The school has taken steps to reduce the amount of homework students receive each day.
examples.trans: 学校已采取措施减少学生每天的家庭作业量。

examples.sentence: By switching to energy-efficient appliances, households can significantly reduce their monthly electricity bills.
examples.trans: 通过改用节能电器，家庭可以大幅降低每月的电费。

examples.sentence: The new policy aims not only to reduce carbon emissions but also to encourage investment in renewable energy.
examples.trans: 新政策不仅旨在减少碳排放，还鼓励对可再生能源的投资。

examples.sentence: Studies have shown that regular physical exercise can reduce the likelihood of developing chronic diseases by up to forty percent.
examples.trans: 研究表明，经常进行体育锻炼可以将患慢性病的可能性降低多达百分之四十。

unpopular.usageZh: 形容词，意为“不受欢迎的；不得人心的”。是 popular 的反义词。常用结构：be unpopular with sb（不受某人欢迎）；an unpopular decision（一个不得人心的决定）。口语和书面语都可用，语气直接。

examples.sentence: The new school rule is unpopular with my classmates.
examples.trans: 这条新校规不受我同学们欢迎。

examples.sentence: He became unpopular after he broke his promise to the team.
examples.trans: 他对团队失信之后，就变得不受欢迎了。

examples.sentence: The manager had to make an unpopular decision to cut the budget.
examples.trans: 经理不得不做出一个不得人心的决定：削减预算。

examples.sentence: Although the policy was unpopular at first, it gradually won public support.
examples.trans: 尽管这项政策起初不受欢迎，但它逐渐赢得了公众的支持。

examples.sentence: Being honest sometimes means taking an unpopular stand rather than following the crowd.
examples.trans: 诚实有时意味着采取不受欢迎的立场，而不是随大流。

examples.sentence: The reform, unpopular as it was among traditionalists, proved essential to the company's long-term survival.
examples.trans: 这项改革虽然在传统派中不受欢迎，但事实证明对公司的长期生存至关重要。

mainstream.usageZh: 名词，意为“主流；主流思想”。常作定语修饰名词，如 mainstream culture（主流文化）、mainstream media（主流媒体）。常用搭配：go mainstream（成为主流）、break away from the mainstream（脱离主流）、enter the mainstream（进入主流）。

family.meaning: 使成为主流；使融入主流

examples.sentence: This kind of music is now part of mainstream culture.
examples.trans: 这种音乐现在已经是主流文化的一部分了。

examples.sentence: The singer became famous after her song went mainstream last year.
examples.trans: 去年她的歌成为主流之后，这位歌手就出名了。

examples.sentence: Many young people prefer music that is different from the mainstream.
examples.trans: 许多年轻人喜欢与主流不同的音乐。

examples.sentence: Once considered a niche interest, online gaming has now fully entered the mainstream.
examples.trans: 网络游戏曾被视为小众爱好，如今已完全进入主流。

examples.sentence: Rather than simply following the mainstream, the director chose to develop a highly personal visual style.
examples.trans: 这位导演没有简单地追随主流，而是选择发展一种极具个人特色的视觉风格。

examples.sentence: Ideas that once challenged the mainstream can, over time, reshape it in ways few could have predicted.
examples.trans: 曾经挑战主流的思想，随着时间推移，可能以几乎无人能预料的方式重塑主流。

unusual.usageZh: 形容词，意为“不寻常的；独特的；罕见的”。可修饰名词，也可用于 It is unusual (for sb) to do sth 结构。语气比 strange 更中性，不一定带有负面含义。

examples.sentence: We saw an unusual bird in the park this morning.
examples.trans: 今天早上我们在公园里看到了一只不寻常的鸟。

examples.sentence: It is unusual for my father to come home before six.
examples.trans: 我爸爸六点前回家是很少见的。

examples.sentence: The teacher noticed an unusual silence in the classroom and asked what had happened.
examples.trans: 老师注意到教室里异常安静，便问发生了什么事。

examples.sentence: Having grown up in a big city, she found the quiet of the village both unusual and comforting.
examples.trans: 在大城市长大的她，觉得乡村的宁静既陌生又令人安心。

examples.sentence: What makes the novel unusual is not its plot, but the way it shifts between past and present without warning.
examples.trans: 这部小说的不寻常之处不在于情节，而在于它在过去与现在之间毫无预兆地切换。

examples.sentence: It is unusual for a scientific theory to gain widespread public attention so quickly, yet that is precisely what happened.
examples.trans: 一种科学理论如此迅速地引起公众广泛关注是罕见的，然而事情恰恰就这样发生了。

expectations.usageZh: 名词，常用复数形式，表示“期望，预期”。常与动词 have, meet, exceed, lower 搭配，也可与形容词 high, low, realistic 连用。语体中性，口语和书面语都常见。

examples.sentence: My parents have high expectations for my grades.
examples.trans: 我父母对我的成绩有很高的期望。

examples.sentence: The movie didn't meet my expectations at all.
examples.trans: 这部电影完全没有达到我的期望。

examples.sentence: If you set realistic expectations, you won't feel so disappointed later.
examples.trans: 如果你设定切合实际的期望，之后就不会那么失望。

examples.sentence: Having grown up in a family of doctors, she felt enormous pressure to live up to their expectations.
examples.trans: 在一个医生世家长大，她感到巨大的压力去不辜负家人的期望。

examples.sentence: The company's quarterly results exceeded even the most optimistic expectations of market analysts.
examples.trans: 该公司的季度业绩甚至超出了市场分析师最乐观的预期。

examples.sentence: Rather than lowering expectations in the face of setbacks, the team chose to reexamine their strategy and redouble their efforts.
examples.trans: 面对挫折，团队没有降低期望，而是选择重新审视策略并加倍努力。

advantages.usageZh: 名词，常用复数形式，表示“优点，优势”。常与动词 have, offer, enjoy, outweigh 搭配，反义词是 disadvantages。常用于议论文或对比类表达中。

examples.sentence: Living near school has many advantages.
examples.trans: 住在学校附近有很多好处。

examples.sentence: One of the advantages of riding a bike is that it keeps you fit.
examples.trans: 骑自行车的好处之一是可以保持健康。

examples.sentence: Although the plan has some risks, its advantages far outweigh the disadvantages.
examples.trans: 虽然这个计划有一些风险，但它的优点远远大于缺点。

examples.sentence: Students who are fluent in a second language enjoy significant advantages in the global job market.
examples.trans: 精通第二语言的学生在全球就业市场上享有显著优势。

examples.sentence: While remote work offers undeniable advantages in terms of flexibility, it also poses challenges for team cohesion.
examples.trans: 虽然远程工作在灵活性方面具有不可否认的优势，但也对团队凝聚力构成了挑战。

examples.sentence: The advantages of early intervention in education are well documented, yet many regions still lack the resources to implement such programs effectively.
examples.trans: 教育中早期干预的优势已有充分文献证明，但许多地区仍缺乏有效实施此类项目的资源。

stressful.usageZh: 形容词，描述使人感到压力大的情况或事物。常用搭配：stressful job, stressful situation, stressful day。也可用于结构 find something stressful。语体中性，口语和书面语均常见。

examples.sentence: The exam week is always stressful for me.
examples.trans: 考试周对我来说总是压力很大。

examples.sentence: Moving to a new city can be a stressful experience for young children.
examples.trans: 搬到一个新城市对小孩子来说可能是一段压力很大的经历。

examples.sentence: If you find your job too stressful, you should talk to your manager about it.
examples.trans: 如果你觉得工作压力太大，应该和经理谈谈。

examples.sentence: Juggling a part-time job with a full course load proved far more stressful than she had anticipated.
examples.trans: 一边做兼职一边上满课程比她预想的要压力大得多。

examples.sentence: Ironically, the very technologies designed to simplify our lives often make them more stressful and fragmented.
examples.trans: 讽刺的是，那些旨在简化我们生活的技术往往让生活变得更有压力、更加碎片化。

examples.sentence: Prolonged exposure to stressful environments can impair cognitive function, which underscores the need for effective coping mechanisms.
examples.trans: 长期处于高压环境会损害认知功能，这凸显了有效应对机制的必要性。

backpacker.usageZh: 可数名词，指背着背包旅行的人。常与 budget、young、solo 等形容词连用。相关动词是 backpack（背包旅行），相关名词是 backpacking（背包旅行这种活动）。

examples.sentence: The backpacker carries a big bag on his back.
examples.trans: 那个背包客背上背着一个大包。

examples.sentence: A young backpacker asked me how to get to the train station.
examples.trans: 一个年轻的背包客问我怎么去火车站。

examples.sentence: The backpacker stayed in a cheap hostel because she wanted to save money for food.
examples.trans: 那个背包客住在一家便宜的青年旅社，因为她想省钱买吃的。

examples.sentence: Having traveled through five countries in three months, the backpacker had learned to pack light and plan ahead.
examples.trans: 在三个月内穿越了五个国家之后，那个背包客学会了轻装上路和提前规划。

examples.sentence: Unlike tourists who follow fixed schedules, a seasoned backpacker tends to leave room for unexpected detours.
examples.trans: 与遵循固定行程的游客不同，经验丰富的背包客往往会为意外的绕行留出空间。

examples.sentence: The rise of remote work has blurred the line between a digital nomad and a long-term backpacker, as both value flexibility over stability.
examples.trans: 远程办公的兴起模糊了数字游民和长期背包客之间的界限，因为两者都更看重灵活性而非稳定性。

reservations.usageZh: 名词，常用复数形式，表示预订的座位、房间或名额。常与 make、have、cancel、confirm 等动词搭配。注意：单数 reservation 也可表示"保留意见"或"疑虑"。

examples.sentence: We have reservations for dinner at six.
examples.trans: 我们预订了六点的晚餐。

examples.sentence: My dad made hotel reservations two weeks before our trip.
examples.trans: 我爸爸在我们旅行前两周就订好了酒店。

examples.sentence: If you want to eat at that popular restaurant, you should make reservations at least three days in advance.
examples.trans: 如果你想在那家热门餐厅吃饭，你应该至少提前三天预订。

examples.sentence: Having failed to secure dinner reservations online, they decided to try their luck by walking in.
examples.trans: 由于没能在网上订到晚餐，他们决定直接去碰碰运气。

examples.sentence: The hotel apologized for losing our reservations, yet the compensation they offered was barely enough to cover the inconvenience.
examples.trans: 酒店为弄丢我们的预订而道歉，但他们提供的补偿几乎不足以弥补不便。

examples.sentence: Despite having confirmed reservations weeks earlier, the family was told upon arrival that no tables were available due to a system error.
examples.trans: 尽管几周前就已确认预订，这家人到达时却被告知由于系统错误没有空桌。

comfortable.usageZh: 形容词，表示"舒适的"或"感到自在的"。可修饰物品（comfortable chair/bed/shoes），也可作表语描述人的感受（feel comfortable with sb/sth）。比较级和最高级为 more comfortable / most comfortable。

examples.sentence: This sofa is soft and comfortable.
examples.trans: 这张沙发又软又舒服。

examples.sentence: She put on her comfortable shoes before going for a long walk.
examples.trans: 在去走远路之前，她穿上了舒适的鞋子。

examples.sentence: The new library has comfortable chairs where students can sit and read for hours.
examples.trans: 新图书馆有舒适的椅子，学生可以坐在那里读好几个小时的书。

examples.sentence: Feeling comfortable enough to ask questions in class is often the first sign that a student has truly settled in.
examples.trans: 在课堂上敢于提问，往往是学生真正适应了的第一个信号。

examples.sentence: A comfortable salary matters less to her than the freedom to work from anywhere she chooses.
examples.trans: 对她来说，丰厚的薪水不如随时随地工作的自由重要。

examples.sentence: The survey revealed that employees who feel comfortable voicing concerns are significantly more likely to stay with their current employer.
examples.trans: 调查显示，敢于表达顾虑的员工留在现任雇主的可能性显著更高。

pros.usageZh: 名词，常用复数形式，表示“优点、好处”。常与 cons 搭配构成固定短语 pros and cons（利弊）。多用于讨论、议论文或做决定时的分析语境。

examples.sentence: One of the pros of this bike is that it is very light.
examples.trans: 这辆自行车的一个优点是它很轻。

examples.sentence: Let's list the pros of taking the bus instead of driving.
examples.trans: 我们来列出坐公交车而不是开车的好处。

examples.sentence: Before you choose a school, think about the pros of each one carefully.
examples.trans: 在你选择学校之前，仔细想想每所学校的优点。

examples.sentence: One of the main pros of studying online is that you can arrange your own schedule.
examples.trans: 在线学习的主要好处之一是你能够自己安排时间。

examples.sentence: While the pros of moving to a bigger city are obvious, the higher living costs should not be ignored.
examples.trans: 尽管搬到大城市的好处显而易见，但更高的生活成本也不应被忽视。

examples.sentence: A balanced evaluation requires weighing the pros of immediate action against the risks of acting without sufficient information.
examples.trans: 一个平衡的评估需要权衡立即行动的好处与在信息不足情况下行动的风险。

cons.usageZh: 名词，常用复数形式，表示“缺点、坏处”。与 pros 相对，常一起用于 pros and cons 短语中。用于分析问题、比较选择或议论文写作。

examples.sentence: The biggest con of this phone is its short battery life.
examples.trans: 这部手机最大的缺点是电池续航时间短。

examples.sentence: We should also talk about the cons of eating too much fast food.
examples.trans: 我们也应该谈谈吃太多快餐的坏处。

examples.sentence: One of the cons of living far from school is that you have to get up very early.
examples.trans: 住得离学校远的一个缺点是你必须很早起床。

examples.sentence: Despite the cons of working from home, such as feeling isolated, many people still prefer it.
examples.trans: 尽管在家工作有缺点，比如感到孤独，许多人仍然更喜欢这种方式。

examples.sentence: The cons of relying heavily on technology become particularly evident when systems fail without warning.
examples.trans: 当系统毫无预警地出现故障时，过度依赖技术的缺点就变得尤为明显。

examples.sentence: Policymakers must confront the cons of rapid urban expansion, including environmental degradation and strained public services.
examples.trans: 政策制定者必须正视快速城市扩张的弊端，包括环境恶化和公共服务紧张。

marvellous.usageZh: 形容词，表示“极好的、令人惊叹的”。英式拼写为 marvellous，美式拼写为 marvelous。常用于口语和书面语中表达强烈赞美，可修饰时间、经历、景色、想法等。

examples.sentence: The cake you made tastes marvellous!
examples.trans: 你做的蛋糕味道好极了！

examples.sentence: We watched a marvellous film about animals last night.
examples.trans: 昨晚我们看了一部关于动物的精彩电影。

examples.sentence: The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely marvellous.
examples.trans: 从山顶看到的景色绝对令人惊叹。

examples.sentence: It is marvellous how a simple act of kindness can completely change someone's day.
examples.trans: 一个简单的善举竟能完全改变某人的一天，这真是令人惊叹。

examples.sentence: The orchestra gave a marvellous performance, drawing enthusiastic applause from the audience throughout the evening.
examples.trans: 管弦乐队奉献了一场精彩的演出，整个晚上赢得了观众热烈的掌声。

examples.sentence: What makes the novel marvellous is not its plot but the author's ability to capture the subtlest shifts in human emotion.
examples.trans: 这部小说的精彩之处不在于情节，而在于作者捕捉人类情感最细微变化的能力。

journey.usageZh: 可数名词。强调旅行过程本身，常指长途旅行。与 'trip'（短途旅行）和 'travel'（泛指旅行）有细微差别。常用搭配：make a journey, go on a journey, a long journey, the journey home。

examples.sentence: The journey to my grandma's house takes two hours by bus.
examples.trans: 去我奶奶家的旅程坐公交车要花两个小时。

examples.sentence: We packed some sandwiches and water before starting the long journey.
examples.trans: 在开始长途旅行之前，我们打包了一些三明治和水。

examples.sentence: Although the journey was tiring, the beautiful scenery along the way made it worthwhile.
examples.trans: 尽管旅途很累，但沿途美丽的风景让一切都值得。

examples.sentence: Having saved money for nearly a year, she finally began her journey across Southeast Asia.
examples.trans: 攒了近一年的钱后，她终于开始了穿越东南亚的旅程。

examples.sentence: What matters most is not the destination but the journey itself, a truth that took him years to fully appreciate.
examples.trans: 最重要的不是目的地，而是旅程本身——这个道理他花了很多年才真正领悟。

examples.sentence: The novel traces the protagonist's psychological journey from self-doubt to quiet confidence, mirroring the social upheavals of the era.
examples.trans: 这部小说追踪了主人公从自我怀疑到平静自信的心理历程，映照出那个时代的社会动荡。

attract.usageZh: 及物动词。常用结构：attract someone / attract someone to something。也可用于被动语态 be attracted to。名词形式是 attraction，形容词是 attractive。

examples.sentence: The smell of fresh bread attracts people into the bakery.
examples.trans: 新鲜面包的香味把人们吸引进面包店。

examples.sentence: The new shopping mall attracts thousands of visitors every weekend.
examples.trans: 这个新购物中心每个周末吸引成千上万的游客。

examples.sentence: The science museum uses interactive exhibits to attract young people who might otherwise find physics boring.
examples.trans: 科学博物馆利用互动展品来吸引那些原本可能觉得物理很无聊的年轻人。

examples.sentence: The company hopes that offering flexible working hours will attract a wider range of talented applicants.
examples.trans: 公司希望通过提供灵活的工作时间来吸引更广泛的有才华的求职者。

examples.sentence: Unlike its competitors, the brand attracts customers not through aggressive advertising but through genuine product quality.
examples.trans: 与竞争对手不同，这个品牌吸引顾客靠的不是激进的广告，而是真正的产品质量。

examples.sentence: The city's decision to invest heavily in public art has attracted both international acclaim and a surge in cultural tourism.
examples.trans: 该市大力投资公共艺术的决策既吸引了国际赞誉，也带来了文化旅游的激增。

treeless.usageZh: 形容词，由名词 tree 加后缀 -less（表示“没有”）构成。用于描述地貌，如 treeless plain, treeless hillside, treeless landscape。

examples.sentence: The top of the hill is treeless, so we can see the whole town from there.
examples.trans: 山顶上没有树，所以从那里我们可以看到整个小镇。

examples.sentence: After walking for an hour across the treeless field, we finally saw a small farmhouse.
examples.trans: 在无树的田野上走了一个小时后，我们终于看到了一座小农舍。

examples.sentence: The treeless island looked empty from the boat, but it was actually home to thousands of seabirds.
examples.trans: 从船上看，这个无树的岛屿显得空荡荡的，但它实际上是成千上万只海鸟的家园。

examples.sentence: Standing on the treeless plateau, the explorers felt completely exposed to the fierce wind.
examples.trans: 站在无树的高原上，探险者们感到完全暴露在猛烈的风中。

examples.sentence: The treeless landscape stretched for miles, its stark emptiness both beautiful and unsettling.
examples.trans: 无树的景观绵延数英里，其荒凉的空旷既美丽又令人不安。

examples.sentence: Centuries of overgrazing have transformed the once-wooded valley into a treeless expanse, a stark reminder of human impact on fragile ecosystems.
examples.trans: 几个世纪的过度放牧把曾经树木繁茂的山谷变成了一片无树的广阔地带，这是人类对脆弱生态系统影响的鲜明警示。

opportunities.usageZh: 名词，常用复数形式，表示“机会；时机”。常与动词 have、get、offer、seize、miss、create 搭配。可接不定式作后置定语，如 opportunities to do sth。口语和书面语均常用，正式语境中常与 ample、equal、career 等词连用。

family.meaning: 机会主义者；投机取巧者
机会主义的；投机取巧的

examples.sentence: My school gives us many opportunities to play sports.
examples.trans: 我的学校给我们很多运动的机会。

examples.sentence: Living in a big city gives you more opportunities to find a good job.
examples.trans: 住在大城市给你更多找到好工作的机会。

examples.sentence: If you miss this opportunity, you may not get another one soon.
examples.trans: 如果你错过这次机会，可能很快不会有下一次了。

examples.sentence: The exchange program offers students valuable opportunities to experience different cultures.
examples.trans: 这个交流项目为学生提供了体验不同文化的宝贵机会。

examples.sentence: Unlike his previous job, this position provides ample opportunities for professional growth and independent research.
examples.trans: 与他之前的工作不同，这个职位为职业发展和独立研究提供了充足的机会。

examples.sentence: Those who actively seek out learning opportunities, rather than waiting for them to appear, tend to adapt more quickly to changing industries.
examples.trans: 那些主动寻找学习机会而不是等待机会出现的人，往往能更快地适应不断变化的行业。

wildlife.usageZh: 不可数名词，作为集合名词使用，指某地区的野生动物。常与 protect、observe、see 等动词搭配，也可作定语修饰 habitat、photography 等名词。

examples.sentence: We saw a lot of wildlife in the forest.
examples.trans: 我们在森林里看到了很多野生动物。

examples.sentence: The lake is a good place to watch wildlife early in the morning.
examples.trans: 这个湖是清晨观察野生动物的好地方。

examples.sentence: If we cut down too many trees, local wildlife will lose their homes.
examples.trans: 如果我们砍掉太多树，当地的野生动物将失去家园。

examples.sentence: The wetland provides a safe habitat for a wide variety of wildlife, including rare birds and small mammals.
examples.trans: 这片湿地为包括珍稀鸟类和小型哺乳动物在内的多种野生动物提供了安全的栖息地。

examples.sentence: Unlike zoos, nature reserves allow visitors to observe wildlife in its natural surroundings without disturbing it.
examples.trans: 与动物园不同，自然保护区让游客在不打扰野生动物的情况下，在自然环境中观察它们。

examples.sentence: The expansion of farmland into previously untouched areas has placed enormous pressure on wildlife, forcing many species to migrate or face extinction.
examples.trans: 农田向原先未开发地区的扩张给野生动物带来了巨大压力，迫使许多物种迁徙或面临灭绝。

passengers.usageZh: 可数名词，是 passenger 的复数形式，指乘坐交通工具但不驾驶的人。常与 train、bus、plane、ship 等交通工具连用，也可与动词 board、carry、transport 搭配。

examples.sentence: The bus is full of passengers.
examples.trans: 公交车上坐满了乘客。

examples.sentence: Passengers should wait behind the yellow line on the platform.
examples.trans: 乘客应在站台上站在黄线后面等候。

examples.sentence: All passengers must show their tickets before they get on the train.
examples.trans: 所有乘客在上火车前必须出示车票。

examples.sentence: The airline apologized to passengers whose flights had been delayed by the heavy snow.
examples.trans: 航空公司向因大雪导致航班延误的乘客道歉。

examples.sentence: Passengers travelling with young children are advised to board the plane first, while those seated at the rear are asked to wait.
examples.trans: 带幼儿出行的乘客建议优先登机，而坐在后部的乘客则被要求等候。

examples.sentence: Despite the severe turbulence, the crew remained calm and ensured that all passengers were securely fastened in their seats throughout the flight.
examples.trans: 尽管遭遇严重气流颠簸，机组人员保持镇定，确保所有乘客在整个飞行过程中都系好安全带坐在座位上。

sightseeing.usageZh: 不可数名词，指游览名胜的活动。常与 go、do 搭配，如 go sightseeing、do some sightseeing。也可作定语修饰 tour、bus、trip 等名词。

examples.sentence: We went sightseeing in Beijing last summer.
examples.trans: 去年夏天我们去北京观光了。

examples.sentence: My parents like to do some sightseeing when they visit a new city.
examples.trans: 我父母去一个新城市时喜欢到处观光。

examples.sentence: After we checked into the hotel, we spent the whole afternoon sightseeing around the old town.
examples.trans: 入住酒店后，我们整个下午都在老城区观光。

examples.sentence: The city offers a free sightseeing bus that takes visitors to all the major attractions.
examples.trans: 这座城市提供免费观光巴士，带游客前往所有主要景点。

examples.sentence: Rather than spending the entire trip sightseeing, we decided to spend one day exploring local markets and chatting with residents.
examples.trans: 我们没有把整个行程都花在观光上，而是决定花一天时间逛逛当地市场，和居民聊聊天。

examples.sentence: Exhausted from a full day of sightseeing in the summer heat, we welcomed the chance to rest in a shaded courtyard with cold drinks.
examples.trans: 在夏日酷暑中观光了一整天后，我们欣然接受了在阴凉庭院里喝冷饮休息的机会。

a bunch of.usageZh: 量词短语，后接可数名词复数或不可数名词。常用于非正式语境，表示“许多、一大堆”。口语中比 a lot of 更随意，常带有“成捆、成束”的原始意象。

examples.sentence: Mum bought a bunch of bananas at the market this morning.
examples.trans: 妈妈今天早上在市场买了一串香蕉。

examples.sentence: There are a bunch of new books on the shelf in our classroom.
examples.trans: 我们教室的书架上有一批新书。

examples.sentence: A bunch of us decided to stay after school and clean up the playground.
examples.trans: 我们一群人决定放学后留下来打扫操场。

examples.sentence: He came up with a bunch of creative ideas for the school science fair.
examples.trans: 他为学校科学展想出了一大堆有创意的点子。

examples.sentence: Rather than buying a bunch of cheap souvenirs, she chose one handmade item that truly represented the local culture.
examples.trans: 她没有买一大堆廉价纪念品，而是选了一件真正代表当地文化的手工制品。

examples.sentence: A bunch of studies have shown that regular exposure to nature significantly reduces stress levels among urban residents.
examples.trans: 大量研究表明，经常接触自然能显著降低城市居民的压力水平。

away from.usageZh: 介词短语，后接名词、代词或名词性短语。表示空间上的“远离”或抽象意义上的“脱离、避开”。常与 be, stay, keep, move 等动词搭配使用。

examples.sentence: My grandparents live in a small village away from the city.
examples.trans: 我的祖父母住在远离城市的一个小村庄里。

examples.sentence: Please stand away from the edge of the platform while waiting for the train.
examples.trans: 等火车时请站得离站台边缘远一点。

examples.sentence: The doctor told him to stay away from sugary drinks for a while.
examples.trans: 医生让他暂时远离含糖饮料。

examples.sentence: Taking a short break away from your phone can help you focus better on your homework.
examples.trans: 暂时放下手机休息一下，能帮你更好地专注于作业。

examples.sentence: The small coastal town, far away from the tourist crowds, offers visitors a rare sense of peace and authenticity.
examples.trans: 这座远离游客人群的沿海小镇，给游客带来一种难得的宁静与真实感。

examples.sentence: Researchers suggest that keeping teenagers away from screens for at least an hour before bedtime improves both sleep quality and academic performance.
examples.trans: 研究人员建议，让青少年在睡前至少一小时远离屏幕，既能改善睡眠质量，也能提升学业表现。

go for.usageZh: 动词短语，后接名词或动名词。常见含义：①选择某物；②去做某事（如散步、游泳）；③适用于某人/某事。口语和书面语均常用，语体中性偏口语。

examples.sentence: Let's go for ice cream after school today.
examples.trans: 今天放学后我们去吃冰淇淋吧。

examples.sentence: My dad likes to go for a run along the river every morning.
examples.trans: 我爸爸喜欢每天早上沿着河边跑步。

examples.sentence: If you want a light meal, I'd go for the chicken salad rather than the burger.
examples.trans: 如果你想吃清淡一点，我会选鸡肉沙拉而不是汉堡。

examples.sentence: After comparing several travel packages, we finally went for the one that included a guided tour of the old town.
examples.trans: 比较了几个旅行套餐后，我们最终选了包含老城导览的那个。

examples.sentence: When it comes to choosing a career, many graduates go for stability over high pay, especially in uncertain economic times.
examples.trans: 在职业选择上，许多毕业生更倾向于稳定而非高薪，尤其是在经济不确定的时期。

examples.sentence: Faced with a tight deadline, the team went for a simpler design that could be delivered on time without sacrificing quality.
examples.trans: 面对紧迫的截止日期，团队选择了一个更简单的设计方案，既能按时交付，又不牺牲质量。

world view.usageZh: 名词短语，通常作宾语或主语。常见搭配：change/expand/broaden/shape one's world view。语体偏正式，适合书面表达和议论文。

family.meaning: 世界观（单数形式，与 world view 同义）

examples.sentence: Traveling to new places can change your world view.
examples.trans: 去新的地方旅行可以改变你的世界观。

examples.sentence: My grandfather's world view is very different from mine because he grew up in a small village.
examples.trans: 我爷爷的世界观和我的很不一样，因为他在一个小村庄长大。

examples.sentence: Living abroad for a year gave her a much wider world view than she had before.
examples.trans: 在国外生活一年让她的世界观比以前开阔得多。

examples.sentence: Reading literature from various countries gradually shaped his world view in ways he had never expected.
examples.trans: 阅读各国文学作品以他从未预料到的方式逐渐塑造了他的世界观。

examples.sentence: A scientific world view does not reject wonder; rather, it deepens our appreciation of how remarkable the universe is.
examples.trans: 科学的世界观并不排斥惊奇，反而加深了我们对宇宙之奇妙的欣赏。

examples.sentence: Exposure to conflicting ideologies forced the young philosopher to reexamine the very foundations of his world view.
examples.trans: 接触相互冲突的意识形态迫使这位年轻哲学家重新审视自己世界观的根基。

loved ones.usageZh: 名词短语，固定表达，通常作宾语或主语。指家人或亲近的人。常见搭配：reunite with / spend time with / protect / lose one's loved ones。

examples.sentence: I like to cook dinner for my loved ones on weekends.
examples.trans: 我喜欢在周末为我的家人做晚饭。

examples.sentence: She always sends postcards to her loved ones when she travels to a new city.
examples.trans: 她去新城市旅行时总会给亲人寄明信片。

examples.sentence: After the earthquake, many people used their phones to call their loved ones and make sure they were safe.
examples.trans: 地震后，许多人用手机给亲人打电话，确认他们是否安全。

examples.sentence: The soldier wrote letters every week, knowing that his loved ones were waiting anxiously for news of his safety.
examples.trans: 这名士兵每周都写信，因为他知道亲人们正焦急地等待他平安的消息。

examples.sentence: In times of crisis, people often realize that time spent with loved ones matters far more than material possessions.
examples.trans: 在危机时刻，人们往往意识到与亲人共度的时光远比物质财富重要。

examples.sentence: The study revealed that individuals who maintain close connections with their loved ones tend to recover from trauma more quickly than those who isolate themselves.
examples.trans: 研究表明，与亲人保持密切联系的人往往比自我孤立的人更快从创伤中恢复。

comparing to.usageZh: 介词短语，后接名词、代词或名词性短语，表示"与……相比"。更正式的书面写法是 compared to。comparing to 常见于口语或非正式文本中，作状语。

examples.sentence: Comparing to my old bike, this new one is much faster.
examples.trans: 和我的旧自行车相比，这辆新的快多了。

examples.sentence: Comparing to the small town where I grew up, this city has many more restaurants and shops.
examples.trans: 与我长大的小镇相比，这座城市有更多的餐馆和商店。

examples.sentence: Comparing to the first time I gave a speech, I feel much less nervous now.
examples.trans: 与我第一次演讲时相比，我现在感觉不那么紧张了。

examples.sentence: Comparing to traditional classrooms, online courses offer students far greater flexibility in managing their study schedules.
examples.trans: 与传统课堂相比，在线课程让学生在安排学习时间上拥有更大的灵活性。

examples.sentence: Comparing to the elaborate rituals of the past, modern weddings tend to emphasize personal expression over rigid tradition.
examples.trans: 与过去繁复的仪式相比，现代婚礼更强调个人表达而非刻板的传统。

examples.sentence: Comparing to the economic policies adopted in the previous decade, the current reforms place considerably more emphasis on sustainable development.
examples.trans: 与过去十年所采取的经济政策相比，当前的改革更加重视可持续发展。

based on.usageZh: 介词短语，后接名词、代词或名词性短语。常用作状语或后置定语，表示“以……为基础/依据”。口语和书面语都常见，但正式写作中更常用。

examples.sentence: This cartoon is based on a funny book.
examples.trans: 这部动画片是根据一本有趣的书改编的。

examples.sentence: Our school rules are based on respect for every student.
examples.trans: 我们的校规以尊重每一位学生为基础。

examples.sentence: The teacher gave each group a different task based on their reading level.
examples.trans: 老师根据每个小组的阅读水平布置了不同的任务。

examples.sentence: Based on the weather forecast, the sports meeting has been put off until next Friday.
examples.trans: 根据天气预报，运动会被推迟到了下周五。

examples.sentence: The report, based on data collected from over 2,000 teenagers, reveals a clear link between sleep and memory.
examples.trans: 这份基于2000多名青少年数据收集的报告揭示了睡眠与记忆之间的明确联系。

examples.sentence: Decisions about college majors should be based on a realistic assessment of one's strengths rather than on temporary enthusiasm.
examples.trans: 关于大学专业的选择，应当基于对自身优势的现实评估，而非一时的热情。

crowds of.usageZh: 名词短语，后接复数名词，尤指“people”。表示“成群的、大量的（人）”。多用于描述公共场所、节假日或热门景点的拥挤场景。

examples.sentence: Crowds of children ran to the playground after lunch.
examples.trans: 午饭后，成群的孩子们跑向操场。

examples.sentence: Crowds of fans waited outside the stadium to see the basketball star.
examples.trans: 成群的球迷在体育馆外等候，想见那位篮球明星。

examples.sentence: When the museum opened its doors, crowds of visitors rushed in to see the new dinosaur exhibition.
examples.trans: 博物馆开门时，成群结队的参观者涌入馆内参观新的恐龙展览。

examples.sentence: Crowds of passengers gathered around the information desk after the flight was suddenly cancelled.
examples.trans: 航班突然取消后，成群的乘客围在咨询台周围。

examples.sentence: Unlike the quiet countryside where she grew up, the city center was always filled with crowds of hurried commuters.
examples.trans: 与她成长的宁静乡村不同，市中心总是挤满了匆忙的通勤人群。

examples.sentence: Despite the heavy rain, crowds of determined protesters remained outside the city hall, holding banners and chanting slogans.
examples.trans: 尽管下着大雨，成群坚定的抗议者仍留在市政厅外，举着横幅高喊口号。

trade it for.usageZh: 动词短语，结构为 trade + 宾语 + for + 交换物，表示“用……交换……”。常与 would not / wouldn't 连用，表示“不愿舍弃某物去换取另一物”，带有情感色彩。

examples.sentence: I have a red pencil, and my friend wants to trade it for a blue one.
examples.trans: 我有一支红铅笔，我的朋友想用一支蓝铅笔来换。

examples.sentence: My little brother offered me his toy car, but I wouldn't trade my football for it.
examples.trans: 弟弟把他的玩具车给我，但我不愿意用我的足球去换。

examples.sentence: She loves her seat by the window so much that she won't trade it for a seat in the front row.
examples.trans: 她太喜欢靠窗的座位了，甚至不愿用它换前排的座位。

examples.sentence: Having grown up in this small town, he wouldn't trade his peaceful life for the excitement of a big city.
examples.trans: 在这个小镇长大的他，不愿用自己平静的生活去换大城市的繁华。

examples.sentence: The old fisherman was offered a large sum of money for his boat, but he refused to trade it for anything, saying it carried a lifetime of memories.
examples.trans: 有人出高价买老渔夫的船，但他拒绝用任何东西来交换，说这艘船承载了他一生的回忆。

examples.sentence: Once you have earned the trust of your colleagues through years of honest work, never trade it for short-term personal gain.
examples.trans: 一旦通过多年诚实工作赢得了同事的信任，就绝不要为了一时的私利而将它舍弃。

used to be.usageZh: 短语，后接名词、形容词或动词原形，表示过去的状态或习惯，现在已不再如此。常用于对比过去和现在。口语和书面语都常见，否定形式为 didn't use to be 或 used not to be。

examples.sentence: My dad used to be a cook, but now he works in an office.
examples.trans: 我爸爸以前是个厨师，但现在他在办公室工作。

examples.sentence: This street used to be very quiet, but now it is full of cars every morning.
examples.trans: 这条街过去很安静，但现在每天早上都挤满了车。

examples.sentence: She used to be afraid of speaking in public, but she became confident after joining the debate club.
examples.trans: 她过去害怕当众讲话，但加入辩论社后变得自信了。

examples.sentence: The building that now houses the city library used to be a railway station until the late 1990s.
examples.trans: 现在用作市图书馆的那栋楼，在20世纪90年代末之前曾是一个火车站。

examples.sentence: Although he used to be one of the most promising players on the team, a serious injury forced him to give up professional football.
examples.trans: 尽管他曾是队里最有前途的球员之一，但一次重伤迫使他放弃了职业足球。

examples.sentence: The river, which used to be so polluted that no fish could survive in it, has been gradually restored to a healthy ecosystem over the past decade.
examples.trans: 这条河过去污染严重到没有鱼能存活，经过过去十年的治理，已逐渐恢复为健康的生态系统。

first of all.usageZh: 副词短语，用于引出第一个要点、理由或步骤，常与 then, second, finally 等连用。通常放在句首，后面用逗号隔开。口语和书面语都常用，语气比 firstly 更自然。

examples.sentence: First of all, wash your hands before you eat anything.
examples.trans: 首先，吃东西之前要洗手。

examples.sentence: First of all, we need to find out why the computer keeps turning itself off.
examples.trans: 首先，我们需要弄清楚电脑为什么总是自动关机。

examples.sentence: First of all, I want to apologize for arriving late because of the heavy traffic.
examples.trans: 首先，我想为因交通拥堵而迟到表示歉意。

examples.sentence: First of all, the report points out that regular exercise can significantly reduce the risk of heart disease.
examples.trans: 首先，报告指出，经常锻炼可以显著降低患心脏病的风险。

examples.sentence: First of all, it must be admitted that the new policy has brought considerable benefits to small businesses, despite its initial unpopularity.
examples.trans: 首先，必须承认，新政策尽管起初不受欢迎，但已给小企业带来了相当大的好处。

examples.sentence: First of all, any meaningful discussion of climate change must acknowledge that the scientific consensus is overwhelming and that delaying action only increases the eventual cost.
examples.trans: 首先，任何关于气候变化的有意义的讨论都必须承认，科学共识是压倒性的，拖延行动只会增加最终的代价。

compared to.usageZh: 介词短语，用于引出比较对象，意为“与……相比”。可放在句首或句末。compared to 和 compared with 在多数情况下可互换，但 compared to 更常用于强调相似性，compared with 更常用于强调差异。

examples.sentence: My new school is very big compared to my old one.
examples.trans: 和我的旧学校相比，我的新学校很大。

examples.sentence: The weather in Kunming is warm all year compared to many other cities in China.
examples.trans: 与中国许多其他城市相比，昆明的天气全年都很温暖。

examples.sentence: Compared to last year, the number of students who walk to school has increased a lot.
examples.trans: 与去年相比，步行上学的学生人数增加了很多。

examples.sentence: Compared to traditional textbooks, digital learning materials can be updated far more quickly and at a much lower cost.
examples.trans: 与传统教科书相比，数字化学习材料可以更快地更新，而且成本低得多。

examples.sentence: The unemployment rate in this region remains relatively low compared to the national average, largely thanks to its booming tourism industry.
examples.trans: 与全国平均水平相比，该地区的失业率仍然相对较低，这在很大程度上得益于其蓬勃发展的旅游业。

examples.sentence: Compared to the enormous sums spent on treating diseases after they develop, investing in preventive healthcare is not only more humane but also far more economical in the long run.
examples.trans: 与疾病发生后用于治疗所花费的巨额资金相比，投资于预防性医疗不仅更人道，而且从长远来看也经济得多。

from door to door.usageZh: 副词短语，常用来描述运输或服务的直达性，表示“从出发地直接到目的地”。可修饰动词如 deliver、travel、take、send 等。口语和书面语都常见，尤其用于物流、交通场景。

examples.sentence: The school bus takes us from door to door every day.
examples.trans: 校车每天把我们门到门地接送。

examples.sentence: This moving company can carry your things from door to door, so you don't need to worry about the heavy boxes.
examples.trans: 这家搬家公司可以把你的东西门到门地搬运，所以你不用担心那些重箱子。

examples.sentence: If you book the airport transfer service, a driver will pick you up from door to door.
examples.trans: 如果你预订机场接送服务，司机会门到门地来接你。

examples.sentence: The new high-speed rail link allows passengers to travel from door to door without changing trains.
examples.trans: 这条新的高铁线路让乘客无需换乘就能门到门地出行。

examples.sentence: Unlike traditional postal services, private couriers often guarantee delivery from door to door, which saves customers considerable time.
examples.trans: 与传统邮政服务不同，私营快递公司通常保证门到门递送，这为顾客节省了大量时间。

examples.sentence: For elderly residents living alone, a pharmacy that delivers medicine from door to door can be a lifeline, especially during harsh winters.
examples.trans: 对于独居的老年居民来说，一家能门到门送药的药店可能是一条生命线，尤其是在严冬期间。

worth mentioning.usageZh: 形容词短语，表示“值得一提”。常用结构：It is worth mentioning that + 从句；或 Something is worth mentioning。多用于书面语和正式口语中，用来引出补充说明或强调某个亮点。

examples.sentence: My little brother can count to one hundred, and that is worth mentioning.
examples.trans: 我弟弟能数到一百，这件事值得一提。

examples.sentence: It is worth mentioning that our class collected over 200 books for the school library.
examples.trans: 值得一提的是，我们班为学校图书馆收集了200多本书。

examples.sentence: The report is worth mentioning because it shows how much the river has been cleaned up in the past five years.
examples.trans: 这份报告值得一提，因为它显示了这条河在过去五年里被清理得有多干净。

examples.sentence: It is worth mentioning that the experiment was repeated three times to ensure the results were reliable.
examples.trans: 值得一提的是，该实验重复了三次以确保结果可靠。

examples.sentence: What is particularly worth mentioning is that the author wrote the entire novel while working a full-time job.
examples.trans: 特别值得一提的是，作者是在做全职工作的同时写完了整部小说。

examples.sentence: Among the many factors contributing to the project's success, it is worth mentioning that the team maintained open communication with local communities throughout the process.
examples.trans: 在促成该项目成功的众多因素中，值得一提的是团队在整个过程中始终与当地社区保持开放沟通。

take part in.usageZh: 动词短语，后接名词或动名词，表示“参加、参与”。比 join 更强调参与活动或事件的过程。可用于体育、比赛、社会活动、讨论等多种场景，口语和书面语都常用。

examples.sentence: I want to take part in the school sports meeting this year.
examples.trans: 我今年想参加学校运动会。

examples.sentence: Many students in our grade will take part in the English speech contest next Friday.
examples.trans: 我们年级的许多学生将在下周五参加英语演讲比赛。

examples.sentence: If you take part in the volunteer program, you will learn how to work with people of different ages.
examples.trans: 如果你参加这个志愿者项目，你将学会如何与不同年龄的人合作。

examples.sentence: Taking part in extracurricular activities helps students develop skills that cannot be learned from textbooks alone.
examples.trans: 参加课外活动有助于学生培养仅靠课本无法学到的技能。

examples.sentence: She was reluctant to take part in the debate at first, but once she started speaking, her arguments proved remarkably persuasive.
examples.trans: 她起初不愿参加辩论，但一旦开始发言，她的论点被证明非常有说服力。

examples.sentence: Researchers who take part in long-term field studies must be prepared to adapt to unpredictable conditions and maintain detailed records over extended periods.
examples.trans: 参与长期实地研究的研究人员必须准备好适应不可预测的条件，并在较长时间内保持详细记录。

a lot of.usageZh: 形容词短语，修饰可数名词复数或不可数名词，表示数量多。口语和书面语都常用，语气比 many 和 much 更随意。注意：a lot of 不用于正式程度极高的学术写作，但在日常交流和一般写作中非常自然。

family.meaning: 许多，大量（比 a lot of 更口语化）

examples.sentence: There are a lot of apples on the tree in my grandpa's garden.
examples.trans: 我爷爷的花园里那棵树上有许多苹果。

examples.sentence: My sister drinks a lot of milk every morning because she wants to grow taller.
examples.trans: 我妹妹每天早上喝很多牛奶，因为她想长得更高。

examples.sentence: If you spend a lot of time practicing the piano, you will see real improvement soon.
examples.trans: 如果你花大量时间练习钢琴，你很快就会看到真正的进步。

examples.sentence: Moving to a new city requires a lot of courage, especially when you don't know anyone there.
examples.trans: 搬到一个新城市需要很大的勇气，尤其是当你在那里一个人都不认识的时候。

examples.sentence: The researchers collected a lot of data over the three-year period, yet the results remained inconclusive.
examples.trans: 研究人员在三年期间收集了大量数据，但结果仍然没有定论。

examples.sentence: A lot of evidence suggests that consistent sleep patterns contribute more to academic performance than last-minute cramming does.
examples.trans: 大量证据表明，规律的睡眠模式比考前临时抱佛脚对学业表现的贡献更大。

pros and cons.usageZh: 名词短语，总是以复数形式使用，表示事物的正反两面。常与动词 weigh、consider、discuss、evaluate 搭配。语体偏正式，但在日常讨论中也常用。注意不要拆开写成 pro and con。

examples.sentence: My dad wrote down the pros and cons of buying a new bike before he said yes.
examples.trans: 我爸爸在同意之前把买新自行车的利与弊写了下来。

examples.sentence: Before choosing a summer camp, let's list the pros and cons of each one together.
examples.trans: 在选择夏令营之前，我们一起把每个夏令营的优缺点列出来吧。

examples.sentence: When you compare the pros and cons of living in the city and the countryside, you will find that each has its own charm.
examples.trans: 当你比较住在城市和乡村的利与弊时，你会发现各有各的魅力。

examples.sentence: The committee spent two hours weighing the pros and cons of relocating the school library to the new building.
examples.trans: 委员会花了两个小时权衡把学校图书馆迁到新楼的利弊。

examples.sentence: Rather than dismissing the proposal immediately, the board carefully evaluated the pros and cons of adopting a fully remote work policy.
examples.trans: 董事会没有立即否决该提案，而是仔细评估了采用完全远程办公政策的利弊。

examples.sentence: A balanced argument should present the pros and cons of genetic engineering without letting emotional appeals overshadow factual analysis.
examples.trans: 一篇均衡的议论文应当呈现基因工程的利弊，而不让情感诉求盖过事实分析。

break time.usageZh: 名词短语，表示“休息时间”或“假期”。常作宾语或表语，前面可用形容词修饰，如 short break time、common break time。口语和书面语均可使用，学校场景中尤其常见。

examples.sentence: We play basketball during break time.
examples.trans: 我们在休息时间打篮球。

examples.sentence: After a long morning of classes, the students were glad to have a twenty-minute break time.
examples.trans: 上了一上午的课之后，学生们很高兴有二十分钟的休息时间。

examples.sentence: The library is always crowded during break time because many students go there to read quietly.
examples.trans: 休息时间图书馆总是很拥挤，因为许多学生去那里安静地看书。

examples.sentence: Having a proper break time between study sessions allows your brain to process new information more effectively.
examples.trans: 在学习时段之间安排适当的休息时间，能让大脑更有效地处理新信息。

examples.sentence: Unlike a quick pause between lessons, a longer break time such as a winter holiday gives families a chance to travel together.
examples.trans: 与课间短暂的停顿不同，像寒假这样较长的假期能让家人有机会一起旅行。

examples.sentence: Research suggests that students who take regular break time during intensive revision retain vocabulary at a significantly higher rate than those who study without interruption.
examples.trans: 研究表明，在密集复习期间定期休息的学生，其词汇保持率明显高于不间断学习的学生。

break away from.usageZh: 动词短语，后接名词或名词短语，表示“摆脱、脱离”某种状态、群体、习惯或传统。可用于具体或抽象语境，如 break away from tradition、break away from the group。书面语和口语均常见。

examples.sentence: The little dog tried to break away from the rope.
examples.trans: 小狗试图挣脱绳子。

examples.sentence: He decided to break away from his bad habit of staying up too late.
examples.trans: 他决定改掉熬夜太晚的坏习惯。

examples.sentence: The young cyclist managed to break away from the main group and took the lead in the final lap.
examples.trans: 那位年轻的自行车手成功摆脱了主车群，在最后一圈取得了领先。

examples.sentence: To develop your own style as a writer, you need to break away from imitating others and find your own voice.
examples.trans: 要形成自己的写作风格，你需要摆脱模仿他人，找到自己的声音。

examples.sentence: Some travellers deliberately break away from popular tourist routes, preferring remote villages where they can experience local life untouched by mass tourism.
examples.trans: 一些旅行者有意避开热门旅游路线，更喜欢偏远的村庄，在那里体验未被大众旅游影响的本土生活。

examples.sentence: A truly independent thinker is willing to break away from widely accepted assumptions, even when doing so invites criticism from the majority.
examples.trans: 真正独立的思想者愿意摆脱被广泛接受的假设，即使这样做会招致多数人的批评。

turn out to be.usageZh: 动词短语，后接形容词或名词，表示“结果是、证明是”。结构为：主语 + turn out to be + 形容词/名词。常用于描述与预期不同或出乎意料的结果，口语和书面语均适用。

examples.sentence: The small box turned out to be a gift for me.
examples.trans: 那个小盒子原来是给我的礼物。

examples.sentence: The new student seemed shy at first, but she turned out to be very friendly and funny.
examples.trans: 那位新同学起初看起来很害羞，但结果她非常友好又有趣。

examples.sentence: The path looked short on the map, but it turned out to be a long and tiring walk through the hills.
examples.trans: 这条路在地图上看起来很短，但结果却是一段漫长而累人的山路。

examples.sentence: What initially appeared to be a minor technical problem turned out to be a serious security issue affecting thousands of users.
examples.trans: 最初看似一个小技术问题，结果却是一个影响数千用户的严重安全漏洞。

examples.sentence: The job offer, which had seemed too good to refuse, turned out to be far less attractive once the hidden costs of relocation were taken into account.
examples.trans: 那份工作邀请曾经看起来好得让人无法拒绝，但一旦把搬迁的隐性成本考虑进去，结果就没那么有吸引力了。

examples.sentence: The ancient manuscript, long dismissed as a forgery by leading scholars, turned out to be an authentic document that reshaped our understanding of early trade routes.
examples.trans: 那份长期被权威学者斥为赝品的古代手稿，结果却是一份真实的文献，重塑了我们对早期贸易路线的理解。

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense / 现在完成时
grammar.title: 现在完成时：从基本结构到 have been / have gone / 与一般过去时的语域区分
grammar.titleEn: Present Perfect Tense: Core Structures, Continuative Uses, and Contrast with Past Simple
grammar.usage:
现在完成时由“have/has + 过去分词”构成，核心功能是连接过去与现在。它主要表达两类含义：一是过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，例如“I have lost my key”强调现在钥匙不见了；二是从过去某一时间开始一直持续到现在的动作或状态，例如“She has lived here since 2015”强调从2015年至今一直住在这里。肯定句用“主语 + have/has + 过去分词”，否定句在 have/has 后加 not，疑问句把 have/has 提到主语前。

在高中阶段，现在完成时不仅要掌握“已完成”和“未完成”两种基本用法，还要重点区分它与一般过去时的语域差异。一般过去时只陈述过去某个具体时间发生的动作，与现在无关，常与 yesterday、last week、in 2010 等明确的过去时间连用；而现在完成时不与这类具体过去时间连用，常与 already、yet、just、ever、never、so far、up to now、for + 时间段、since + 时间点等连用。例如“I saw that movie yesterday”只是说明昨天看了电影，而“I have seen that movie”则强调我现在知道电影内容，或者有相关经验。

初中用法通常只要求识别 for 和 since 引导的持续状态，以及 already、yet 在肯定和否定句中的位置。高中用法则进一步要求掌握 have been to、have gone to、have been in 的区别，理解现在完成进行时与现在完成时的细微差异，并能在书面语中根据语境判断是否需要用现在完成时来体现“过去对现在的影响”。此外，高中还常考查现在完成时在时间状语从句中的特殊用法，例如在“It is the first time that...”句型中，从句要用现在完成时。

易错点方面，第一，不要把现在完成时与表示具体过去时间的状语连用，不能说“I have seen him yesterday”；第二，have gone to 表示“去了某地还没回来”，have been to 表示“去过某地已经回来”，两者不可混淆；第三，since 后面接时间点，for 后面接时间段，不能说“since two years”；第四，在“It is + 时间段 + since...”句型中，since 从句常用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时或一般现在时，需要根据语境判断。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + have/has + 过去分词（+ 其他）
否定句：主语 + have/has + not + 过去分词（+ 其他）
一般疑问句：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词（+ 其他）？
特殊疑问句：疑问词 + have/has + 主语 + 过去分词（+ 其他）？
have been to + 地点：去过某地（已回来）
have gone to + 地点：去了某地（未回来）
have been in + 地点：在某地待了多久（持续状态）
notes: 高考书面语中，现在完成时常与“so far / up to now / in recent years / over the past decade”等表示“从过去到现在”的时间状语连用，体现语篇的连贯性。
在“This is the first time that...”句型中，that 从句必须用现在完成时，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频考点。
have been to 和 have gone to 的区别在高考听力中常通过语境判断说话人位置，注意 have gone to 的主语通常不是第一人称。
现在完成时与一般过去时在同一段落中交替使用时，一般过去时用于叙述具体过去事件，现在完成时用于总结或强调与现在的关联，这种语域转换在高考完形填空中很常见。
书面语中，现在完成时的被动语态“have/has been + 过去分词”常用来描述已经完成的政策、研究或变化，例如“New measures have been taken to address the issue.”

examples.en: I have already finished my homework.
examples.cn: 我已经完成我的作业了。

examples.en: She has lived in Shanghai for ten years.
examples.cn: 她在上海已经住了十年了。

examples.en: He has never been to Beijing, but he has read a lot about it.
examples.cn: 他从未去过北京，但他读过很多关于北京的书。

examples.en: My brother has gone to the library, so he can't answer the phone right now.
examples.cn: 我哥哥去图书馆了，所以他现在不能接电话。

examples.en: This is the first time that I have visited a foreign country.
examples.cn: 这是我第一次访问外国。

examples.en: In recent years, significant progress has been made in the field of artificial intelligence.
examples.cn: 近年来，人工智能领域已经取得了重大进展。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework, so I can play now.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时表示过去动作对现在造成影响，所以现在可以玩了。

exercises.q: She ______ in this school since 2020.
exercises.explain: since 2020 是现在完成时的标志词，表示从过去持续到现在。

exercises.q: They ______ to Beijing twice.
exercises.explain: twice 表示经历，用 have been to 表示去过某地。

exercises.q: My brother ______ his key. He can't open the door.
exercises.explain: 丢钥匙对现在造成影响——开不了门，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: We ______ each other for five years.
exercises.explain: for five years 表示持续一段时间，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: He ______ (live) here since he was a child.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I ______ (not see) that movie yet.
exercises.explain: yet 用于现在完成时否定句，表示还没做某事。

exercises.q: ______ you ever ______ (eat) sushi?
exercises.explain: ever 用于现在完成时疑问句，询问是否曾经做过某事。

exercises.q: She has gone to Shanghai. She is not here now.
exercises.explain: has gone to 表示去了某地还没回来，所以人不在这里。

exercises.q: I have bought this book last week.
exercises.explain: last week 是过去时间点，不能与现在完成时连用，应改为一般过去时。

exercises.q: He has finished his work. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: He has not finished his work.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定形式在 have/has 后加 not。

exercises.q: They have visited the museum. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 现在完成时疑问句把 have/has 提到主语前。

exercises.q: I can swim. (用 be able to 改写)
exercises.explain: can 与 be able to 同义，表示能力。

exercises.q: She have finished her homework.
exercises.explain: 主语是第三人称单数 she，应用 has 而不是 have。

exercises.q: I have saw that movie before.
exercises.answer: I have seen that movie before.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时中 see 的过去分词是 seen，不是 saw。

exercises.q: He ______ the book for two weeks. He needs to return it.
exercises.explain: borrow 是短暂动词，不能与 for two weeks 连用，需用延续性动词 keep。

exercises.q: —Where is Tom? —He ______ to the library.
exercises.explain: has gone to 表示去了某地还没回来，符合语境。

exercises.q: I ______ my English teacher since I left school.
exercises.explain: since 引导过去时间点，主句用现在完成时否定形式。

exercises.q: She ______ already ______ the letter.
exercises.explain: already 是现在完成时标志词，主语 she 用 has。

exercises.q: The film ______ for ten minutes when we arrived.
exercises.explain: arrived 是过去动作，电影在到达前已开始，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: So far, we ______ (learn) 500 English words.
exercises.explain: so far 表示到目前为止，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: It's the first time I ______ (visit) this city.
exercises.explain: It's the first time 后接现在完成时，表示第一次做某事。

exercises.q: He ______ (be) to the Great Wall twice.
exercises.explain: has been to 表示去过某地，twice 表示次数。

exercises.q: I have joined the club for three years.
exercises.explain: join 是短暂动词，不能与 for three years 连用，应改为 have been in。

exercises.q: She has been to Beijing three times, so she knows the city well.
exercises.explain: has been to 表示去过某地并已回来，符合语境。

exercises.q: He came here five minutes ago. (用 for five minutes 改写)
exercises.answer: He has been here for five minutes.
exercises.explain: 短暂动词 come 需改为延续性动词 be，才能与 for 时间段连用。

exercises.q: She bought the car two years ago. (用 since two years ago 改写)
exercises.answer: She has had the car since two years ago.
exercises.explain: buy 是短暂动词，需改为延续性动词 have，与 since 连用。

exercises.q: I have never read such an interesting book. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Have you ever read such an interesting book?
exercises.explain: never 在疑问句中改为 ever，have 提前。

exercises.q: He has left his hometown for ten years.
exercises.answer: He has been away from his hometown for ten years.
exercises.explain: leave 是短暂动词，不能与 for ten years 连用，需改为 be away from。

exercises.q: I have gone to the Great Wall before.
exercises.answer: I have been to the Great Wall before.
exercises.explain: 表示曾经去过某地应用 have been to，have gone to 表示去了还没回来。

exercises.q: By the time we got to the station, the train ______.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，火车离开发生在到达之前，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ in this company since she graduated from college.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间点，强调从过去持续到现在并可能继续，用现在完成进行时。

exercises.q: It is the most beautiful city I ______.
exercises.explain: It is + 最高级 + 名词 + 现在完成时，表示至今为止的经历。

exercises.q: He ______ the novel twice, and he wants to read it again.
exercises.explain: twice 表示经历，且对现在有影响（想再读），用现在完成时。

exercises.q: Not only Tom but also his parents ______ to the party.
exercises.explain: not only...but also 连接并列主语时，谓语与最近的主语 his parents 保持一致，用复数。

exercises.q: By the end of last year, they ______ (build) three bridges.
exercises.explain: by the end of last year 是过去完成时的标志，表示到去年年底为止已完成的动作。

exercises.q: This is the second time he ______ (make) the same mistake.
exercises.explain: This is the second time 后接现在完成时，表示到目前为止第几次做某事。

exercises.q: She ______ (wait) for you for two hours and she is still waiting.
exercises.explain: 强调从过去持续到现在且仍在进行，用现在完成进行时。

exercises.q: He has been in the army for three years, so he has joined the army for three years.
exercises.explain: join 是短暂动词，不能与 for three years 连用，后半句应改为 has been in the army。

exercises.q: I had finished my homework before my mother came back.
exercises.explain: before 引导过去时间，主句动作发生在从句之前，用过去完成时正确。

exercises.q: He began to teach English in 2010. (用 since 2010 改写)
exercises.explain: begin 是短暂动词，需改为延续性动词 teach，与 since 连用。

exercises.q: She has never been to Japan. (改为反意疑问句)
exercises.answer: She has never been to Japan, has she?
exercises.explain: 陈述部分含 never 表否定，反意疑问句用肯定形式 has she。

exercises.q: I have studied English for six years. (对 for six years 提问)
exercises.answer: How long have you studied English?
exercises.explain: 对时间段提问用 how long，现在完成时结构不变。

exercises.q: The children have been to the zoo yesterday.
exercises.answer: The children went to the zoo yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 是过去时间点，不能与现在完成时连用，应改为一般过去时。

exercises.q: She has bought the house since 2015.
exercises.answer: She has had the house since 2015.
exercises.explain: buy 是短暂动词，不能与 since 连用，需改为延续性动词 have。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework, so I can go out to play now.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时表示过去动作对现在造成影响，所以现在可以出去玩。

exercises.q: She ______ in this city since 2018.
exercises.explain: since 2018 表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: They ______ to the new museum twice this month.
exercises.explain: this month 是未结束的时间段，且强调次数，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: My brother ______ his keys. He can't find them anywhere.
exercises.explain: 丢钥匙对现在造成影响——现在找不到，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: We ______ each other for ten years.
exercises.explain: for ten years 表示持续到现在的时间段，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: He ______ (already / eat) lunch, so he isn't hungry.
exercises.explain: already 常与现在完成时连用，表示动作已经完成。

exercises.q: I ______ (not see) that movie yet.
exercises.explain: yet 用于现在完成时否定句，表示还没做某事。

exercises.q: She ______ (be) a teacher since she graduated.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间点，表示从过去持续到现在的状态。

exercises.q: He has gone to Beijing yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 是明确的过去时间，不能与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: I have lived here for three years.
exercises.explain: for three years 表示持续到现在的时间段，用现在完成时正确。

exercises.q: She has finished her work. (改为否定句)
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定在 have/has 后加 not。

exercises.q: They have visited the Great Wall. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Have they visited the Great Wall?
exercises.explain: 现在完成时疑问句将 have/has 提到主语前。

exercises.q: I have been to Shanghai. He has been to Shanghai too. (用 so 合并)
exercises.answer: I have been to Shanghai, and so has he.
exercises.explain: so + have/has + 主语 表示某人也一样。

exercises.q: She have finished her homework.
exercises.explain: 主语是第三人称单数，要用 has 而不是 have。

exercises.q: I have saw that film before.
exercises.answer: I have seen that film before.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时中动词要用过去分词，see 的过去分词是 seen。

exercises.q: By the time we arrived at the station, the train ______.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，表示过去的过去，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ in this company since she graduated from college.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间点，强调从过去持续到现在且可能继续，用现在完成进行时。

exercises.q: This is the first time I ______ such a beautiful sunset.
exercises.explain: This is the first time 后用现在完成时，表示到目前为止的经历。

exercises.q: He ______ abroad three times in the past five years.
exercises.explain: in the past five years 表示从过去到现在的时间段，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I ______ my keys. I can't open the door.
exercises.explain: 丢钥匙对现在造成影响，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ (write) three emails so far this morning.
exercises.explain: so far 表示到目前为止，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: It's the best book I ______ (ever / read).
exercises.explain: ever 与现在完成时连用，表示曾经经历。

exercises.q: They ______ (know) each other since they were children.
exercises.explain: since 引导过去时间点，表示持续到现在的状态。

exercises.q: He has been to London three times last year.
exercises.explain: last year 是明确的过去时间，不能用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I have been studying English for six years.
exercises.explain: for six years 表示持续到现在的时间段，现在完成进行时正确。

exercises.q: She started working here in 2019. She still works here. (用 since 合并)
exercises.explain: since 引导时间点，表示从过去持续到现在的动作。

exercises.q: I have never eaten such delicious food. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Have you ever eaten such delicious food?
exercises.explain: 现在完成时疑问句中 never 变为 ever。

exercises.q: He has finished his homework. He can watch TV now. (用 because 合并)
exercises.answer: He can watch TV now because he has finished his homework.
exercises.explain: because 引导原因状语从句，现在完成时表示动作已完成。

exercises.q: I have been knowing him for many years.
exercises.answer: I have known him for many years.
exercises.explain: know 是状态动词，通常不用进行时，用现在完成时即可。

exercises.q: She has went to the library.
exercises.answer: She has gone to the library.
exercises.explain: go 的过去分词是 gone，不是 went。

exercises.q: By the end of next month, she ______ in this company for ten years.
exercises.explain: by the end of next month 表示将来某时间点前完成，用将来完成时。

exercises.q: Not only ______ the exam, but he also got the highest score in his class.
exercises.explain: not only 置于句首时，主句要部分倒装，且此处用一般过去时。

exercises.q: It is the third time that the famous writer ______ our city.
exercises.explain: It is the third time that 后用现在完成时，表示到目前为止的经历。

exercises.q: ______ that the company has changed its policy regarding overseas travel.
exercises.explain: It is reported that 是固定句型，表示据报道。

exercises.q: Hardly ______ the airport when the plane took off.
exercises.explain: hardly...when 句型中 hardly 置于句首要倒装，且用过去完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ (work) on this project for three months by the time it was completed.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，表示过去的过去，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: The number of people who ______ (travel) abroad has increased dramatically over the past decade.
exercises.explain: over the past decade 表示从过去到现在的时间段，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: Never before ______ I ______ (see) such a magnificent view.
exercises.explain: never before 置于句首要倒装，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: She has been working here since she has graduated from college.
exercises.explain: since 引导的从句用一般过去时，不用现在完成时。

exercises.q: By the time he arrived, the meeting had already begun.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，主句用过去完成时表示过去的过去。

exercises.q: I have never met such a talented artist. (改为倒装句)
exercises.answer: Never have I met such a talented artist.
exercises.explain: 否定词 never 置于句首，句子要部分倒装。

exercises.q: She started learning French five years ago. She is still learning French. (用 for 合并)
exercises.answer: She has been learning French for five years.
exercises.explain: for five years 表示持续到现在的时间段，用现在完成进行时。

exercises.q: The last time I saw him was three years ago. (用 since 改写)
exercises.answer: I haven't seen him since three years ago.
exercises.explain: since three years ago 表示从三年前到现在，用现在完成时否定。

exercises.q: Having been finished his homework, he went out to play.
exercises.answer: Having finished his homework, he went out to play.
exercises.explain: 现在分词完成式主动形式是 having done，不用被动语态。

exercises.q: It is the first time that I had visited the museum.
exercises.answer: It is the first time that I have visited the museum.
exercises.explain: It is the first time that 后用现在完成时，不用过去完成时。

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: 动名词作主语：从基础用法到高中拓展（含 it 形式主语、逻辑主语及与不定式的对比）
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Subject: Basic to Advanced Usage
grammar.usage:
动名词是动词的 -ing 形式，在句中起名词作用。当动名词或动名词短语位于句首充当主语时，表示一种泛指的、习惯性的或抽象的活动或概念，而不是某一次具体的动作。核心结构为“动名词（短语）+ 谓语动词”，此时谓语动词一律用第三人称单数形式。例如：Traveling gives you a chance to learn something new. 否定形式是在动名词前直接加 not，如：Not exercising regularly can lead to health problems. 疑问形式通常借助 it 作形式主语来构成，如：Is it worth spending so much time on this?

在初中阶段，动名词作主语主要考查“句首动词用 -ing 形式”以及“谓语动词用单数”这两个基本点。进入高中后，动名词作主语的使用范围明显扩大：一是与 it 形式主语结构结合，如 It is no use doing sth. / It is worth doing sth. / It is a waste of time doing sth.；二是动名词可以带有自己的逻辑主语，如 Tom's being late again made the teacher angry；三是动名词作主语时常与不定式作主语形成对比，动名词侧重“泛指、已有经验或一般性事实”，不定式侧重“具体、将来或一次性动作”。

动名词作主语与不定式作主语是高中阶段的重要对比点。动名词作主语通常表示抽象的、习惯性的或已知的活动，如 Swimming is good for health. 而不定式作主语往往表示具体的、尚未发生的动作，如 To swim in this river is dangerous. 在 It is + 形容词 + doing/to do 结构中，部分形容词有固定搭配倾向，如 important, necessary, difficult 后多用不定式，而 no use, no good, worth, a waste of time 后只用动名词。

易错点一：句首动词形式判断。祈使句用动词原形开头，动名词作主语用 -ing 形式开头，两者不可混淆。例如：Reading books opens your mind.（动名词作主语）与 Read the book carefully.（祈使句）。易错点二：动名词作主语时，谓语动词的单复数。无论动名词短语有多长、是否带有宾语或状语，谓语动词始终用单数。易错点三：动名词的否定形式。否定词 not 必须放在动名词之前，不能放在谓语动词之后。易错点四：动名词与现在分词作定语或状语的区分。动名词作主语时是名词性功能，而现在分词作状语时表示伴随或原因，如 Hearing the news, she cried.（现在分词作状语，不是主语）。
forms: Gerund (phrase) + 单数谓语动词：Traveling gives you a chance to learn.
Not + Gerund + 单数谓语动词：Not sleeping enough affects your memory.
It + is + no use/no good/worth + Gerund：It is no use crying over spilt milk.
Gerund + 宾语/状语（扩展的动名词短语作主语）：Learning a foreign language takes time.
逻辑主语（名词所有格/形容词性物主代词）+ Gerund + 谓语：Tom's being late again made the teacher angry.
It + is + 形容词（important/necessary/difficult）+ to do（对比：不定式作主语）：It is important to learn English well.
notes: 动名词作主语时，谓语动词必须用第三人称单数形式，即使动名词短语中包含复数名词或并列结构也不例外。
否定动名词时，not 要放在动名词之前，如 Not doing homework is a bad habit，而不是 Doing not homework。
高考书面语中，动名词作主语常与 it 形式主语结构搭配，如 It is no use doing sth.，此时真正的主语是后面的动名词短语，it 只是形式主语。
在正式语域中，动名词的逻辑主语常用名词所有格或形容词性物主代词表示，如 John's winning the prize surprised everyone，口语中也可用宾格形式 John winning the prize。
动名词作主语与不定式作主语在语域上有分工：动名词更常见于书面语和一般性论述，不定式更常见于表达具体目的或未发生的动作。

examples.en: Swimming is good for your health.
examples.cn: 游泳对你的健康有益。

examples.en: Learning English takes time and practice.
examples.cn: 学习英语需要时间和练习。

examples.en: Not getting enough sleep can affect your memory.
examples.cn: 睡眠不足会影响你的记忆力。

examples.en: It is no use crying over spilt milk.
examples.cn: 覆水难收，哭也无用。

examples.en: Tom's being late again made the teacher very angry.
examples.cn: 汤姆再次迟到让老师非常生气。

examples.en: It is worth spending some time reflecting on your long-term goals rather than merely focusing on short-term gains.
examples.cn: 花一些时间反思你的长期目标是值得的，而不是仅仅关注短期利益。

exercises.q: ______ is a good way to keep healthy.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，表示泛指的活动。

exercises.q: ______ English every day helps you remember new words.
exercises.explain: 句首用动名词作主语，谓语动词用单数。

exercises.q: ______ too much sugar is bad for your teeth.
exercises.explain: 动名词短语作主语，表示吃糖这一行为。

exercises.q: ______ in the sun for a long time can be dangerous.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，谓语用第三人称单数形式。

exercises.q: ______ to music makes me feel relaxed.
exercises.explain: 句首动名词作主语，表示听音乐这一活动。

exercises.q: ______ (swim) is my favorite sport in summer.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，注意双写m再加ing。

exercises.q: ______ (draw) pictures makes her very happy.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，谓语动词用单数makes。

exercises.q: ______ (get) up early is good for your health.
exercises.explain: 动名词短语作主语，表示早起这一习惯。

exercises.q: Play basketball is fun.
exercises.explain: 动词原形不能作主语，应改为Playing basketball。

exercises.q: Reading books opens your mind.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，谓语动词用单数opens，句子正确。

exercises.q: It is fun to ride a bike. (改为动名词作主语)
exercises.explain: 用动名词短语作主语替换形式主语it结构。

exercises.q: Cooking is interesting. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语时，变疑问句将be动词提前。

exercises.q: Watching TV is relaxing. (改为否定句)
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，否定句在be动词后加not。

exercises.q: Swim in the river is dangerous.
exercises.answer: Swimming in the river is dangerous.
exercises.explain: 动词原形不能作主语，应改为动名词Swimming。

exercises.q: Eating vegetables are good for you.
exercises.answer: Eating vegetables is good for you.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语时谓语动词用单数is。
