exercises.q: ______ a foreign language takes a lot of time and effort.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，表示学习语言这一过程。

exercises.q: ______ too much time on video games is not good for students.
exercises.explain: 动名词短语作主语，表示花费时间这一行为。

exercises.q: ______ in a big city has both advantages and disadvantages.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，谓语动词用单数has。

exercises.q: ______ a good habit is important for teenagers.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，表示培养习惯这一行为。

exercises.q: ______ to bed late makes you feel tired the next day.
exercises.explain: 动名词短语作主语，谓语动词用单数makes。

exercises.q: ______ (collect) stamps is an interesting hobby.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，表示集邮这一爱好。

exercises.q: ______ (help) others gives us a sense of happiness.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，谓语动词用单数gives。

exercises.q: ______ (keep) a diary every day can improve your writing.
exercises.explain: 动名词短语作主语，表示坚持写日记这一习惯。

exercises.q: To travel around the world is my dream.
exercises.explain: 不定式也可以作主语，句子语法正确。

exercises.q: Making friends are important for young people.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语时谓语动词用单数is。

exercises.q: It is important to exercise every day. (改为动名词作主语)
exercises.explain: 用动名词短语作主语替换形式主语it结构。

exercises.q: Reading in poor light is bad for your eyes. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Is reading in poor light bad for your eyes?
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，变疑问句将be动词提前。

exercises.q: Playing computer games is a waste of time. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: Playing computer games is not a waste of time.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，否定句在be动词后加not。

exercises.q: To learn a new skill require patience.
exercises.answer: Learning a new skill requires patience.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语时谓语动词用单数requires。

exercises.q: Watching too much TV are harmful to your eyes.
exercises.answer: Watching too much TV is harmful to your eyes.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语时谓语动词用单数is。

exercises.q: ______ a healthy diet and exercising regularly are both essential for maintaining good health.
exercises.explain: 动名词短语与exercising并列作主语。

exercises.q: ______ in extracurricular activities can significantly enhance a student's college application.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，谓语动词用单数can enhance。

exercises.q: ______ a balance between study and leisure is crucial for students' mental well-being.
exercises.explain: 动名词短语作主语，表示取得平衡这一行为。

exercises.q: ______ new challenges often leads to personal growth and increased confidence.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，谓语动词用单数leads。

exercises.q: ______ a second language fluently requires years of consistent practice and immersion.
exercises.explain: 动名词短语作主语，表示说第二语言这一能力。

exercises.q: ______ (volunteer) at the local community center has taught me valuable life skills.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，谓语动词用单数has taught。

exercises.q: ______ (procrastinate) on important tasks often results in unnecessary stress.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，表示拖延这一行为。

exercises.q: ______ (expose) yourself to different cultures broadens your perspective on the world.
exercises.explain: 动名词短语作主语，谓语动词用单数broadens。

exercises.q: Being able to adapt to new environments are an important skill in today's globalized world.
exercises.explain: 动名词短语作主语时谓语动词用单数is。

exercises.q: Learning from one's mistakes is a sign of maturity.
exercises.explain: 动名词短语作主语，谓语动词用单数is，句子正确。

exercises.q: It is essential to develop critical thinking skills. (改为动名词作主语)
exercises.answer: Developing critical thinking skills is essential.
exercises.explain: 用动名词短语作主语替换形式主语it结构。

exercises.q: Managing time wisely is a key to success. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Is managing time wisely a key to success?
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，变疑问句将be动词提前。

exercises.q: Taking risks is necessary for innovation. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: Taking risks is not necessary for innovation.
exercises.explain: 动名词作主语，否定句在be动词后加not。

exercises.q: To pursue higher education abroad require careful planning and financial preparation.
exercises.answer: Pursuing higher education abroad requires careful planning and financial preparation.

grammar.title: 比较结构：compared to/with 与 comparing to 的用法及拓展
grammar.titleEn: Comparative Structures: compared to/with, comparing to, and Related Patterns
grammar.usage:
比较结构用于说明两个事物之间的异同或相对关系。高中阶段最核心的是 compared to/with 和 comparing to 两种形式。compared to/with 是过去分词短语，在句中作状语，通常放在句首或句尾，表示“与……相比”，其逻辑主语与主句主语一致。例如：Compared with his brother, Tom is more outgoing.（与他哥哥相比，汤姆更外向。）comparing to 是现在分词短语，带有主动意味，常出现在非正式口语或较随意的书面语中，表示“如果把……拿来比较的话”，但高中书面表达中更推荐使用 compared to/with。

肯定句结构为“Compared to/with + 名词/代词, 主句”，否定形式一般在主句中使用否定词，如 Compared to last year, the situation is not better. 疑问形式则通常借助主句的疑问结构，如 Compared with before, has anything changed? 需要注意的是，compared to/with 本身不随人称和时态变化，因为它是一个固定的分词短语。

compare A with B 侧重“把A和B进行对比，找出异同”，常用于具体分析；compare A to B 除了可以表示“把A和B相比”之外，还常表示“把A比作B”，具有比喻色彩。例如：We compared the results with the original data.（我们把结果与原始数据进行了对比。）Shakespeare compared the world to a stage.（莎士比亚把世界比作舞台。）高中阶段还常见 in comparison with/by comparison 等介词短语，用于正式书面语，如 In comparison with other countries, this figure is relatively low.

初中阶段主要要求掌握 compared to/with 的基本含义和简单句中的位置，以及 compare A with B 的固定搭配。高中阶段则进一步要求：能在复杂句中使用分词短语作状语，注意逻辑主语一致；能区分 compare to 与 compare with 的语义侧重；能在书面表达中灵活运用 in comparison with、by comparison、relative to 等更正式的比较表达；能识别 comparing to 的非正式语域特征，并在正式写作中替换为 compared to/with。

易错点一：分词短语的逻辑主语问题。Compared to/with 的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致，否则会造成悬垂结构。例如：Compared with other students, the exam was easy for him. 这句话是错误的，因为 compared 的逻辑主语应该是“他”，而不是“考试”。应改为：Compared with other students, he found the exam easy.
易错点二：compare to 与 compare with 的混用。在表示“比喻”时只能用 compare A to B，不能用 with。例如：Life is often compared to a journey.（生活常被比作一段旅程。）
易错点三：comparing to 在正式写作中的使用。高中书面表达和高考作文中，应避免使用 comparing to 作状语，统一使用 compared to/with。
易错点四：compared to 与 compared with 在多数情况下可以互换，但 compared to 更常用于口语和一般性比较，compared with 更侧重细致对比，尤其在学术或正式语体中。
forms: Compared to/with + 名词/代词, + 主句（过去分词短语作状语）
主句 + compared to/with + 名词/代词（分词短语后置）
compare A with B（将A与B进行对比，找出异同）
compare A to B（将A比作B；也可表示将A与B相比）
In comparison with + 名词/代词, + 主句（正式书面语）
By comparison, + 主句（相比之下，用于句首过渡）
notes: 高考书面表达中，compared to/with 作状语时，务必检查其逻辑主语是否与主句主语一致，避免悬垂分词错误。
compare A to B 表示“把A比作B”时，不能用 with 替换，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频考点。
comparing to 属于非正式语域，高考作文和正式书面语中应替换为 compared to/with，避免因语域不当而失分。
in comparison with 和 by comparison 是高中阶段提升书面语档次的常用表达，适合用于议论文和说明文的开头或过渡句。
compared to 与 compared with 在高考中通常可互换，但在强调细致对比或数据分析时，优先使用 compared with 更符合学术语体习惯。

examples.cn: 与传统方法相比，这种新方法被证明更高效。

exercises.q: My schoolbag is bigger ______ yours.

exercises.q: ______ to your city, my hometown is much smaller.
exercises.explain: 过去分词 Compared 作状语，表示"与……相比"，逻辑主语与主句主语一致。

exercises.explain: than 提示用形容词比较级 smaller。

exercises.explain: in our class 表示范围，用最高级 tallest。

exercises.explain: taller 已经是比较级，不能再加 more。

exercises.explain: as...as 中间用原级 long，结构正确。

exercises.explain: 在 be 动词 is 后加 not 构成否定句。

exercises.explain: not as...as 表示"不如……"，中间用原级 big。

exercises.explain: stronger 已是比较级，不能再用 more 修饰。

exercises.explain: 多音节形容词 beautiful 的比较级用 more beautiful。

exercises.explain: Compared with 是固定搭配，作状语表示"与……相比"。

exercises.explain: 用 that 代替前面提到的不可数名词 weather，避免重复。

exercises.explain: 两者中较……的一个用 the + 比较级。

exercises.explain: 用 that 代替不可数名词 population，避免重复。

exercises.q: She sings ______ better than I do.
exercises.explain: much 可以修饰比较级 better，表示"……得多"。

exercises.explain: the more...the more... 结构表示"越……越……"。

exercises.explain: 过去分词 Compared 作状语，与主句主语 he 构成被动关系。

exercises.q: This problem is ______ (difficult) than that one.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词 difficult 的比较级用 more difficult。

exercises.q: The sentence "The more you practice, the better you will become." is correct.
exercises.explain: the more...the better... 结构使用正确，表示"越……越……"。

exercises.explain: 正式书面语中应用 Compared to/with，而非 Comparing to。

exercises.explain: less...than 可转换为 not as...as，意思相同。

exercises.explain: cleverer 已是比较级，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: ______ to the city center, this area is much quieter and cleaner.
exercises.explain: 过去分词 Compared 作状语，与主句主语 this area 构成被动关系。

exercises.q: ______ with traditional teaching methods, online learning offers more flexibility.
exercises.explain: Compared with 是固定搭配，作状语表示"与……相比"。

exercises.q: No other student in the class is as ______ (hard-working) as Lily.

exercises.q: The sentence "The more you worry, the less you will enjoy life." is correct.
exercises.explain: the more...the less... 结构使用正确，表示"越……越不……"。

exercises.explain: 最高级可转换为比较级 + than any other + 单数名词。

exercises.q: If you compare the two plans, you will see the advantages of the second one. (用 Comparing 开头改写)

exercises.q: Comparing to his previous performance, he has improved a lot.

exercises.q: Life in the countryside is quite different ______ life in the big city.

exercises.explain: 过去分词作状语，表示“与……相比”。

grammar.key: Modal Verb for Suggestion / 表建议的情态动词
grammar.title: 表建议的情态动词与建议句型：Why not / Why don't you / should / could / may / might
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verbs and Patterns for Suggestions: Why not / Why don't you / should / could / may / might
grammar.usage:
本语法点围绕“提出建议”这一交际功能展开。核心结构是“Why not + 动词原形...?”，它并不是由单个情态动词构成，而是以疑问句形式表达一种委婉、鼓励性的建议，语气比“You should...”更柔和，相当于“How about...?”或“Let's...”。该结构在口语和书面语中都很常见，尤其在邀请对方尝试某事、改变计划或采取行动时使用。

肯定式建议常用“Why not + 动词原形”，如：Why not plan a trip away from the routine we live in every day? 否定式建议则常借助“Why don't you/we + 动词原形...?”来表达，如：Why don't we take a short break? 疑问式本身即为建议，不需要再添加其他疑问词。回答时通常用“Good idea!”“That sounds great!”“Sure, let's do that.”等表示接受。

与近义结构对比：should 表示“应该做”，语气较为直接，带有一定义务感；could 表示“可以/不妨”，语气更委婉，给对方更多选择空间；may/might 用于建议时语气更正式、更弱，常见于书面语或较正式场合，如“You might consider taking a different approach.”。而“Why not...?”和“Why don't you/we...?”则更口语化，带有邀请和鼓励色彩。

初中阶段主要要求掌握“Why not + 动词原形”和“Why don't you/we + 动词原形”的基本用法，并能区分其与询问原因的“Why...?”句型。高中阶段则进一步要求理解情态动词在建议功能中的语气差异，如 should/could/may/might 的委婉程度、正式程度，并能在书面表达中根据语境选择恰当的建议方式。

易错点：1. “Why not”后必须接动词原形，不能接动名词或不定式；2. “Why don't you/we”后同样接动词原形，且注意主语 you/we 不能省略；3. 不要把“Why not...?”与询问原因的“Why...?”混淆，后者需要助动词和主语，如“Why are you late?”；4. 在正式书面语中，过多使用“Why not...?”可能显得口语化，高考书面表达中可适当替换为“It is advisable to...”“You might consider...”等结构。
forms: Why not + 动词原形...?  （为什么不……呢？）
Why don't you/we + 动词原形...?  （你/我们为什么不……呢？）
You should + 动词原形...  （你应该……）
You could + 动词原形...  （你不妨/可以……）
You may/might + 动词原形...  （你可以/或许可以……）
It is advisable to + 动词原形...  （建议做……，书面语）
notes: “Why not”后面只能接动词原形，不能接动名词或带 to 的不定式，如不能说 Why not going 或 Why not to go。
“Why don't you/we...”中的 you/we 不可省略，且后面同样接动词原形，高考语法填空和短文改错常在此处设空。
区分“Why not...?”（提建议）和“Why...?”（问原因）：后者需要助动词+主语+动词，如“Why did you leave early?”。
高考书面表达中，连续使用“Why not...?”会显得口语化过重，建议在正式文体中替换为“You might consider...”“It is advisable to...”等结构。
could/may/might 表建议时语气依次减弱，might 最委婉、最正式，适合在议论文或建议信中表达委婉观点。

grammar.key: Adverbial Clause of Condition (No matter...) / 条件状语从句 (No matter...)
grammar.title: 条件/让步状语从句：no matter + 疑问词（含 whatever / wherever / however 等拓展）
grammar.titleEn: Adverbial Clauses of Concession with "no matter + question word" (including whatever, wherever, however, etc.)
grammar.usage:
“no matter + 疑问词”结构用于引导让步状语从句，表示“无论……都……”，强调主句所述的情况不会因为从句条件的变化而改变。常见疑问词包括 where, what, who, how, when, which 等，例如 no matter where（无论在哪里）、no matter what（无论什么）、no matter how（无论怎样）。该结构在句中作状语，修饰主句的谓语动词或整个主句。

在肯定句中，结构通常为“No matter + 疑问词 + 主语 + 谓语，主句”；否定形式主要体现在主句或从句的否定词上，例如“No matter what he says, I won't believe him.”。疑问形式一般针对主句提问，例如“Will you support me no matter what happens?”。需要注意的是，从句本身不使用疑问句语序，而是使用陈述句语序。

“no matter + 疑问词”与“疑问词 + ever”在让步状语从句中通常可以互换，例如“No matter where you go”相当于“Wherever you go”。但两者存在重要区别：“no matter + 疑问词”只能引导让步状语从句，不能引导名词性从句；而“whatever / whoever / whichever”等既可以引导让步状语从句，也可以引导主语从句、宾语从句等名词性从句。例如可以说“You can take whatever you like”，但不能说“You can take no matter what you like”。

初中阶段主要要求掌握“no matter what / where / how”等常见搭配的基本含义和简单用法，通常与一般现在时连用表示将来意义。高中阶段则进一步要求理解该结构与“疑问词 + ever”的互换条件及限制，能够在书面表达中准确区分让步状语从句与名词性从句，并学会使用“no matter how + 形容词/副词”等较为复杂的结构来表达程度让步。

易错点一：从句语序误用疑问句语序。例如“No matter where is he”是错误的，应改为“No matter where he is”。易错点二：将“no matter + 疑问词”误用于名词性从句。例如“I don't know no matter what he wants”是错误的，应改为“I don't know what he wants”。易错点三：时态误用。在表示将来意义时，从句通常用一般现在时，而不是将来时。易错点四：混淆“no matter how”与“no matter what”的搭配。“no matter how”后接形容词或副词，如“no matter how hard it is”；“no matter what”后接名词或单独使用，如“no matter what happens”。
forms: No matter + 疑问词 + 主语 + 谓语，主句
No matter + where/what/who/how/when/which + 从句，主句
No matter how + 形容词/副词 + 主语 + 谓语，主句
主句 + no matter + 疑问词 + 从句（从句可后置）
疑问词 + ever + 从句 ≈ No matter + 疑问词 + 从句（仅限让步状语从句）
No matter + 疑问词 + 从句，主句（从句用一般现在时表将来）
notes: “no matter + 疑问词”只能引导让步状语从句，不能引导名词性从句；高考书面表达中需要表达“无论什么”并充当宾语时，应使用 whatever 等“疑问词 + ever”形式。
从句必须使用陈述句语序，不能使用疑问句语序。例如“No matter where he is”正确，“No matter where is he”错误。
在表示将来意义时，让步状语从句中通常用一般现在时，而不是 will 或 be going to。
“no matter how”后必须接形容词或副词，再接主语和谓语；不要误用为“no matter how + 名词”。
在正式书面语中，“疑问词 + ever”结构比“no matter + 疑问词”更常见，尤其在较高级的议论文或说明文中，适当使用 wherever / whatever / however 可以提升语域。

grammar.key: Adjective + Infinitive (It's + adj + to do) / 形容词+不定式
grammar.title: 形容词 + 不定式（It's + adj + to do）及其拓展：for/of sb、too…to、enough to、动名词对比
grammar.titleEn: Adjective + Infinitive (It's + adj + to do): for/of sb, too…to, enough to, and gerund contrast
grammar.usage:
本语法点的核心结构是“It is + 形容词 + (for/of sb) + to do sth”，其中 it 作形式主语，真正的主语是后面的不定式短语。该结构用于评价一个动作、行为或情况，表达“做某事是……的”。肯定句如：It is important to keep calm. 否定句在 is 后加 not：It is not easy to change a habit. 疑问句将 is/was 提前：Is it necessary to bring an umbrella? 回答时常用 It is / It isn't。

在高中阶段，该结构需要进一步区分 for sb 和 of sb 的用法。当形容词描述事情的性质（如 important, difficult, necessary, possible, challenging）时，用 for sb；当形容词描述人的品格或特征（如 kind, nice, careless, wise, brave）时，用 of sb。例如：It was wise of her to refuse the offer. 这类句子常可改写为 She was wise to refuse the offer. 而 for sb 结构一般不能这样改写。

该结构还与 too…to… 和 enough to… 形成拓展关系。too + adj + to do 表示“太……而不能做”，本身含有否定意义；adj + enough + to do 表示“足够……可以做”。例如：It is too late to apologize. / It is early enough to catch the train. 高中书面语中常将 too…to 与 so…that… 句型互换，但要注意 too…to 本身已含否定，不能再加 not。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 It is + adj + to do 的基本评价功能，以及少量 for sb 的用法；高中阶段则要求系统掌握 for/of 的语义差异、too…to 与 enough to 的转换、不定式与动名词在类似语境中的区别，以及该结构在书面表达中的高级替换。

易错点一：形容词后误用动名词。不能说 It is important doing exercise. 应说 It is important to do exercise. 易错点二：主谓一致错误。动词始终与形式主语 It 一致，用 is/was，不受后面名词影响。易错点三：混淆 for 和 of。判断方法是看形容词能否修饰人：能修饰人用 of，不能则用 for。易错点四：too…to 结构中重复否定。例如 It is too difficult to not understand 是错误的，应直接说 It is too difficult to understand. 易错点五：在书面表达中过度使用 It is adj to do 开头，导致句式单一，高中写作应适当替换为 Doing sth is adj 或名词短语作主语。
forms: It is + adj + to do sth
It is + adj + for sb + to do sth
It is + adj + of sb + to do sth
It is + too + adj + to do sth
It is + adj + enough + to do sth
Is/Was it + adj + (for/of sb) + to do sth?
notes: 高考书面表达中，It is adj for/of sb to do 是高频评价句式，但连续使用会显得句式单调，建议与 Doing sth is adj 或名词短语主语交替使用。
for 与 of 的选择关键：形容词若可用来描述人的品格（如 careless, generous, considerate），用 of；若只描述事情本身的性质（如 essential, vital, unavoidable），用 for。
too…to… 本身已含否定，不要再加 not；若需表达肯定意义，可改用 enough to 或 so…that…。
在正式语域中，It is adj that 从句与 It is adj to do 有时可互换，但 that 从句更正式，且需注意虚拟语气：It is essential that he (should) be informed.
不定式与动名词在评价句中并非完全等价：It is nice to meet you 侧重当下或具体行为，Meeting people is nice 侧重一般经验，高中写作需根据语境选择。

exercises.q: It is not easy ______ English well.

exercises.explain: 形容人的品质时用 of，如 kind of you。

exercises.q: It is difficult ______ me to finish the work today.
exercises.explain: 表示对某人来说做某事难，用 for me to do。

exercises.q: ______ is fun to play basketball with friends.
exercises.explain: It 作形式主语，真正主语是 to play basketball。

exercises.q: It is nice ______ see you again.
exercises.explain: 形容词后接不定式，填 to。

exercises.q: It is hard ______ him to get up early.
exercises.explain: 表示对某人来说困难，用 for him。

exercises.q: It is good ______ students to read every day.
exercises.explain: 对学生们来说读书有好处，用 for students。

exercises.q: It is easy learning Chinese.
exercises.explain: 形容词后要用 to learn，不是 learning。

exercises.q: It is important to drink water every day.
exercises.explain: It is + adj + to do 结构正确。

exercises.q: To play the piano is fun. (用 It 开头改写)
exercises.answer: It is fun to play the piano.
exercises.explain: 不定式作主语可改为 It 作形式主语的句型。

exercises.q: It is not easy to ride a bike. (改为肯定句)
exercises.answer: It is easy to ride a bike.
exercises.explain: 去掉 not 即可变为肯定句。

exercises.q: It is important to listen to the teacher. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Is it important to listen to the teacher?
exercises.explain: 将 is 提到句首构成一般疑问句。

exercises.q: It is important study hard.
exercises.answer: It is important to study hard.
exercises.explain: 形容词后缺少不定式符号 to。

exercises.q: It is easy for I to do the homework.
exercises.answer: It is easy for me to do the homework.
exercises.explain: 介词 for 后要用宾格 me，不是主格 I。

exercises.q: It is necessary ______ you to wear a helmet when riding.
exercises.explain: necessary 是描述事情的必要性，用 for you。

exercises.q: It was careless ______ him to lose the key.
exercises.explain: careless 是形容人的品质，用 of him。

exercises.q: It is impossible ______ the work in one day.
exercises.explain: It is + adj + to do，形容词后接不定式。

exercises.q: It is exciting ______ a new place.
exercises.explain: 真正主语是不定式 to visit。

exercises.q: ______ is not safe to swim in this river.
exercises.explain: It 作形式主语，真正主语是 to swim。

exercises.q: It is very kind ______ you to invite us.
exercises.explain: kind 形容人的品质，用 of you。

exercises.q: It is important ______ keep quiet in the library.
exercises.explain: 形容词后接不定式，填 to。

exercises.q: It was difficult ______ her to answer the question.
exercises.explain: 表示对某人来说困难，用 for her。

exercises.q: It is important to not be late for class.
exercises.explain: 不定式的否定形式 to not be 在口语中可接受，结构正确。

exercises.q: It is easy for he to make friends.
exercises.explain: 介词 for 后要用宾格 him，不是 he。

exercises.q: To finish the project on time is hard. (用 It 开头改写)
exercises.answer: It is hard to finish the project on time.
exercises.explain: 不定式主语后置，用 It 作形式主语。

exercises.q: It is possible to solve the problem. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: It is not possible to solve the problem.
exercises.explain: 在 is 后加 not 构成否定句。

exercises.q: It is important to save water. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Is it important to save water?
exercises.explain: 将 is 提到句首构成一般疑问句。

exercises.q: It is important for we to protect the environment.
exercises.answer: It is important for us to protect the environment.
exercises.explain: 介词 for 后要用宾格 us，不是 we。

exercises.q: It is dangerous playing with fire.
exercises.answer: It is dangerous to play with fire.
exercises.explain: 形容词后要用不定式 to play，不是 playing。

exercises.q: It is essential that every student ______ the safety rules.
exercises.explain: It is essential that 后接虚拟语气，动词用原形 know。

exercises.q: It was brave ______ him to admit his mistake in public.
exercises.explain: brave 形容人的品质，用 of him。

exercises.q: It is no use ______ over spilt milk.
exercises.explain: It is no use 后接动名词，是固定搭配。

exercises.q: It remains unclear whether the plan ______ approved.
exercises.explain: 根据语境，计划是否会被批准尚不清楚，用将来时被动。

exercises.q: It is surprising ______ so many people believe the rumor.
exercises.explain: It is surprising that 后接从句，表示令人惊讶的是。

exercises.q: It is considerate ______ you to think of others.
exercises.explain: considerate 形容人的品质，用 of you。

exercises.q: It is vital ______ us to take action immediately.
exercises.explain: vital 描述事情的重要性，用 for us。

exercises.q: It is a pity ______ miss the concert.
exercises.explain: It is a pity to do 表示遗憾做某事，填 to。

exercises.q: It is no good to complain about the past.
exercises.explain: It is no good 后接动名词 complaining，不是不定式。

exercises.q: It is important that he arrives on time.
exercises.explain: It is important that 后接从句，arrives 用一般现在时表将来，结构正确。

exercises.q: To understand the theory fully requires patience. (用 It 开头改写)
exercises.answer: It requires patience to understand the theory fully.
exercises.explain: 不定式主语后置，用 It 作形式主语。

exercises.q: It is possible that he will win the prize. (用不定式改写)
exercises.answer: It is possible for him to win the prize.
exercises.explain: that 从句可转换为 for him to do 结构。

exercises.q: It is not difficult to learn a new language. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Is it not difficult to learn a new language?
exercises.explain: 将 is 提到句首构成一般疑问句，保留否定词。

exercises.q: It is no point to argue with him.
exercises.answer: It is no point arguing with him.
exercises.explain: It is no point 后接动名词 arguing，不是不定式。

exercises.q: It is important that he finishes the report by Friday.
exercises.answer: It is important that he finish the report by Friday.
exercises.explain: It is important that 后接虚拟语气，动词用原形 finish。

exercises.q: It is important ______ enough sleep before an exam.
exercises.explain: 形容词后接不定式作真正主语，构成 It is + adj + to do 结构。

exercises.q: It was very kind ______ you to help me carry the box.
exercises.explain: 当形容词描述人的品质时，用 of 引出逻辑主语。

exercises.q: It is not easy ______ a foreign language well.
exercises.explain: 否定形式中仍保持 It is + adj + to do 结构，不定式作真正主语。

exercises.q: ______ is necessary to drink water every day.
exercises.explain: 形式主语用 It，真正主语是后面的不定式短语。

exercises.q: It was difficult for the little boy ______ the math problem.
exercises.explain: for + 名词/代词后接不定式，表示对某人来说做某事困难。

exercises.q: It is fun ______ (play) basketball with friends after school.
exercises.explain: 形容词 fun 后接不定式，构成 It is + adj + to do 结构。

exercises.q: It was wrong ______ (lie) to your parents about the test result.
exercises.explain: 形容词 wrong 后接不定式，表示对某个行为的评价。

exercises.q: It is dangerous ______ (swim) in the river alone.
exercises.explain: dangerous 后接不定式作真正主语，it 为形式主语。

exercises.q: It is important to listen to the teacher carefully in class.
exercises.explain: 该句正确使用了 It is + adj + to do 结构。

exercises.q: It is easy learning new words every day.
exercises.explain: 形容词 easy 后应接不定式 to learn，而非动名词 learning。

exercises.q: To finish the homework on time is important. (用 It 作形式主语改写)
exercises.answer: It is important to finish the homework on time.
exercises.explain: 将不定式短语后置，用 It 作形式主语。

exercises.q: It is not safe to play with fire. (改为肯定句)
exercises.answer: It is safe to play with fire.
exercises.explain: 去掉否定词 not，保持 It is + adj + to do 结构不变。

exercises.q: It is necessary to wear a seat belt. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Is it necessary to wear a seat belt?
exercises.explain: 将 be 动词 is 提前构成一般疑问句，it 仍为形式主语。

exercises.q: It is important studying for the test.
exercises.answer: It is important to study for the test.
exercises.explain: 形容词 important 后应接不定式 to study，而非动名词 studying。

exercises.q: It were difficult to find the way home.
exercises.answer: It was difficult to find the way home.
exercises.explain: 形式主语 It 作主语时，be 动词用单数 was，与 It 保持一致。

exercises.q: It is unusual ______ him to arrive late for class.
exercises.explain: 当形容词描述行为本身而非人的品质时，用 for 引出逻辑主语。

exercises.q: It was brave ______ the firefighter to enter the burning building.
exercises.explain: brave 描述人的品质，用 of 引出逻辑主语。

exercises.q: It is necessary that every student ______ the school rules.
exercises.explain: It is necessary that 后接虚拟语气，谓语动词用原形 follow。

exercises.q: It took me two hours ______ my homework last night.
exercises.explain: It takes/took sb + 时间 + to do 为固定句型，不定式作真正主语。

exercises.q: It is no use ______ about the past mistakes.
exercises.explain: It is no use 后接动名词，为固定搭配，与 It is + adj + to do 结构不同。

exercises.q: It is considerate ______ you to think of others before yourself.
exercises.explain: considerate 描述人的品质，用 of 引出逻辑主语。

exercises.q: It remains a challenge ______ (balance) study and hobbies.
exercises.explain: It remains + 名词 + to do 结构中，不定式作真正主语。

exercises.q: It is essential ______ (check) your answers before handing in the paper.
exercises.explain: essential 后接不定式，构成 It is + adj + to do 结构。

exercises.q: It was careless of him to leave the door unlocked.
exercises.explain: careless 描述人的品质，用 of 引出逻辑主语，结构正确。

exercises.q: It is impossible for he to finish the task alone.
exercises.explain: 介词 for 后应接宾格 him，而非主格 he。

exercises.q: It is difficult for me to understand this poem. (改为同义句，用 I find it...)
exercises.answer: I find it difficult to understand this poem.
exercises.explain: 用 find it + adj + to do 结构替换 It is + adj + for sb + to do。

exercises.q: It is important to keep calm in an emergency. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: It is not important to keep calm in an emergency.
exercises.explain: 在 be 动词后加 not 构成否定，保持不定式结构不变。

exercises.q: It was very kind of you to invite me. (改为感叹句，用 How)
exercises.answer: How kind of you to invite me!
exercises.explain: 用 How + adj + of sb + to do 构成感叹句，省略 It was。

exercises.q: It is important for students to not cheat in exams.
exercises.answer: It is important for students not to cheat in exams.
exercises.explain: 不定式的否定形式为 not to do，not 应放在 to 之前。

exercises.q: It is no need to worry about the result.

exercises.q: It is essential that every participant ______ the safety guidelines before the experiment begins.
exercises.explain: It is essential that 后接虚拟语气，谓语动词用原形 review。

exercises.q: ______ is generally believed that regular exercise contributes to mental well-being.

exercises.q: It was unwise ______ him to have invested all his savings in that risky project.
exercises.explain: unwise 在此评价人的判断力，用 of 引出逻辑主语。

exercises.q: It is not uncommon for teenagers ______ confused about their identity.
exercises.explain: It is + adj + for sb + to do 结构中，不定式作真正主语。

exercises.q: It was considerate of the committee ______ the meeting until everyone arrived.
exercises.explain: considerate 后接不定式，表示对具体行为的评价。

exercises.q: It is imperative that the government ______ (take) immediate action to address climate change.
exercises.explain: It is imperative that 后接虚拟语气，谓语动词用原形 take。

exercises.q: It is of great significance ______ (preserve) cultural heritage for future generations.
exercises.explain: It is of + 名词 + to do 结构中，不定式作真正主语。

exercises.q: It struck me as odd ______ (find) the door wide open at midnight.
exercises.explain: It strikes sb as + adj + to do 结构中，不定式作真正主语。

grammar.key: Present Simple Passive Voice / 一般现在时被动语态
grammar.title: 一般现在时被动语态：从 am/is/are done 到 by 短语与语域运用
grammar.titleEn: Present Simple Passive Voice: am/is/are + Past Participle and Beyond
grammar.usage:
一般现在时被动语态的核心结构是：主语 + am/is/are + 过去分词（V-ed/V3）。它用于强调动作的承受者，或者当动作的执行者不明确、不重要、不言自明时。肯定句如：The bridge is repaired every year. 否定句在 be 动词后加 not：The bridge is not repaired every year. 一般疑问句把 be 动词提到句首：Is the bridge repaired every year? 特殊疑问句则用“疑问词 + be + 主语 + 过去分词”：When is the bridge repaired?

与主动语态相比，被动语态把焦点从“谁做”转移到“什么事被做”。主动句 They clean the room every day. 强调 they 的行为；被动句 The room is cleaned every day. 强调 room 的状态或常规安排。当需要说明执行者时，用 by + 执行者：The room is cleaned by the staff every day. 但高中阶段要特别注意：并非所有主动句都适合改成被动句，不及物动词（如 happen, appear, arrive）没有被动语态。

初中阶段一般只要求掌握 am/is/are + 过去分词的基本构成，以及“被……”的中文翻译。高中阶段则要进一步理解：被动语态在说明文、新闻报道、科普文章、操作流程和正式书面语中的高频使用；by 短语的省略条件；以及“get + 过去分词”在口语中表被动的非正式用法（如 The window got broken）。此外，高中还需辨析被动语态与系表结构的区别：The door is closed. 既可理解为“门被关上了”（被动动作），也可理解为“门是关着的”（状态），需根据语境判断。

易错点一：be 动词与主语的人称和数不一致。例如主语是复数时误用 is：The rooms is cleaned. 应为 The rooms are cleaned. 易错点二：不规则动词的过去分词形式记错。例如 take 的过去分词是 taken，不是 took；write 是 written，不是 wrote。易错点三：把不及物动词用于被动语态。例如 The accident was happened. 是错误的，应为 The accident happened. 易错点四：在不需要说明执行者时硬加 by 短语，导致句子累赘。例如 English is spoken by people all over the world. 中的 by people 通常可以省略。
forms: 肯定式：主语 + am/is/are + 过去分词（+ by + 执行者）
否定式：主语 + am/is/are + not + 过去分词
一般疑问式：Am/Is/Are + 主语 + 过去分词？
特殊疑问式：疑问词 + am/is/are + 主语 + 过去分词？
口语非正式被动：主语 + get(s) + 过去分词
含情态动词的被动（拓展）：主语 + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词
notes: 高考书面表达中，被动语态常用于描述流程、规则、图表和客观事实，避免通篇使用主动语态导致句式单一。
注意 be 动词与主语的单复数一致：单数用 is，复数用 are，I 用 am。主语为不可数名词时用 is。
不规则动词的过去分词要单独记忆，高考常考的有：take→taken, write→written, break→broken, choose→chosen, give→given, see→seen。
by + 执行者只有在提供重要信息时才使用；如果执行者是人人都知道的、不明确的或无关紧要的，应省略 by 短语，使句子更简洁。
在口语或非正式语域中，get + 过去分词可以表示被动，但正式书面语中仍以 be + 过去分词为主。

exercises.q: The classroom ______ by the students every day.
exercises.explain: 主语是单数，一般现在时被动语态用 is + 过去分词。

exercises.q: English ______ in many countries.

exercises.q: The books ______ on the desk.

exercises.q: The flowers are water by the girl.

exercises.q: People speak English in Australia. (改为被动语态)

exercises.q: The teacher cleans the blackboard. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The blackboard is cleaned by the teacher.
exercises.explain: 主动句宾语变主语，动词变为 is cleaned，by 引出执行者。

exercises.q: They make these toys in China. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: These toys are made in China.
exercises.explain: 主语 these toys 是复数，被动语态用 are made。

exercises.q: The homework are done by the students.
exercises.answer: The homework is done by the students.
exercises.explain: homework 是不可数名词，谓语用单数 is done。

exercises.q: The trees is planted every spring.
exercises.answer: The trees are planted every spring.
exercises.explain: 主语 trees 是复数，be 动词应用 are。

exercises.q: The new library ______ next month.
exercises.explain: next month 表示将来，被动语态用 will be opened。

exercises.q: These photos ______ by my father last year.

exercises.q: The work ______ by hand in this factory.
exercises.explain: work 是不可数名词，被动语态用 is done。

exercises.q: A lot of trees ______ in the park every year.
exercises.explain: 主语 trees 是复数，被动语态用 are planted。

exercises.q: The letter ______ to Tom yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 表示过去，主语单数，被动语态用 was sent。

exercises.q: These machines ______ (make) in Germany.

exercises.q: The windows ______ (break) by the strong wind last night.

exercises.q: The dishes are washed by my sister every evening.
exercises.explain: 一般现在时被动语态结构正确，are washed 表示被洗。

exercises.explain: finish 的过去分词应为 finished，正确形式是 was finished。

exercises.q: They built the house in 2000. (改为被动语态)
exercises.explain: 过去时被动语态：was/were + 过去分词，主语单数用 was built。

exercises.q: The students clean the classroom every day. (改为被动语态)

exercises.explain: 一般现在时被动语态，主语单数用 is cleaned。

exercises.q: People use computers in many ways. (改为被动语态)

exercises.explain: 主语 computers 是复数，被动语态用 are used。

exercises.q: The gifts was given to the children yesterday.
exercises.answer: The gifts were given to the children yesterday.
exercises.explain: 主语 gifts 是复数，过去时被动语态用 were given。

exercises.q: This book is wrote by a famous writer.

exercises.explain: write 的过去分词是 written，不是 wrote。

exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，主句用过去完成时被动语态。

exercises.explain: next month 表示将来，被动语态用 will be put。

exercises.explain: soon 表示将来，被动语态用 will be announced。

exercises.explain: last year 表示过去，主语单数，被动语态用 was pulled。

exercises.explain: by the end of last term 表示过去的过去，用过去完成时被动语态。

exercises.q: The report ______ (submit) before the deadline.
exercises.explain: before the deadline 暗示过去完成时，被动语态用 had been submitted。

exercises.q: The new stadium ______ (complete) by the end of next year.
exercises.explain: by the end of next year 表示将来完成时，被动语态用 will have been completed。

exercises.explain: 过去完成时被动语态结构正确，had been signed 表示在会议开始前已被签署。

exercises.explain: last week 是过去时间，不能用现在完成时，应用 was solved。

exercises.q: They had finished the work before the boss came. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The work had been finished before the boss came.
exercises.explain: 过去完成时被动语态：had been + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The company will launch the new product next month. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The new product will be launched by the company next month.
exercises.explain: 将来时被动语态：will be + 过去分词。

exercises.q: People believe that the earth is round. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: It is believed that the earth is round.
exercises.explain: it 作形式主语的被动语态结构：It is believed that...。

exercises.q: The homework has been finished by the students yesterday.
exercises.answer: The homework was finished by the students yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 是过去时间，不能用现在完成时，应用一般过去时被动语态。

exercises.q: The new bridge will be build next year.
exercises.answer: The new bridge will be built next year.
exercises.explain: build 的过去分词是 built，不是 build。

exercises.q: The classroom ______ by the students every afternoon.
exercises.explain: 主语 The classroom 是单数，一般现在时被动语态用 is + 过去分词。

exercises.q: These books ______ into many languages.
exercises.explain: 主语 These books 是复数，被动语态用 are + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The little boy ______ by his grandmother because his parents work in another city.
exercises.explain: 主语 The little boy 是单数，且是“被照顾”，用 is looked after。

exercises.q: A lot of rice ______ in the south of China.
exercises.explain: rice 是不可数名词，作主语时谓语用单数，被动语态用 is grown。

exercises.q: The windows ______ once a week in our school.
exercises.explain: 主语 The windows 是复数，一般现在时被动语态用 are washed。

exercises.q: English ______ (speak) in many countries around the world.
exercises.explain: English 是不可数名词，被动语态用 is + 过去分词 spoken。

exercises.q: The old bridge ______ (repair) every two years.
exercises.explain: 主语 The old bridge 是单数，一般现在时被动语态用 is repaired。

exercises.q: These photos ______ (take) by my father last summer.
exercises.explain: 时间状语 last summer 表明用一般过去时被动语态 were taken。

exercises.q: The sentence "The homework is finished by Tom every day." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: 一般现在时被动语态结构 is + 过去分词 finished 使用正确。

exercises.q: The sentence "The rooms are clean every morning." is in the passive voice.
exercises.explain: clean 在这里是形容词，不是过去分词，句子是主系表结构而非被动语态。

exercises.q: People grow tea in this area. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: Tea is grown in this area.
exercises.explain: 主动句宾语 tea 变为主语，一般现在时被动语态用 is grown。

exercises.q: The classroom is cleaned by the students every day. (改为主动语态)
exercises.answer: The students clean the classroom every day.
exercises.explain: 被动句中的 by the students 在主动句中作主语，谓语用动词原形 clean。

exercises.q: They make these cars in Germany. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: These cars are made in Germany.
exercises.explain: 主语 these cars 是复数，被动语态用 are made。

exercises.q: The letters is written by the manager every morning.
exercises.answer: The letters are written by the manager every morning.
exercises.explain: 主语 The letters 是复数，be 动词应用 are 而不是 is。

exercises.q: This song is sing by many young people.
exercises.answer: This song is sung by many young people.
exercises.explain: sing 的过去分词是 sung，被动语态中应使用过去分词形式。

exercises.q: The new library ______ next month, and it will be open to the public in autumn.
exercises.explain: 时间状语 next month 表明用一般将来时被动语态 will be completed。

exercises.q: The students ______ not to use mobile phones during the exam.
exercises.explain: 主语 The students 是复数，且是“被告知”，用 are told。

exercises.q: A lot of trees ______ along the river every spring to protect the environment.
exercises.explain: 主语 A lot of trees 是复数，一般现在时被动语态用 are planted。

exercises.q: The famous painting ______ in this museum for over twenty years.
exercises.explain: 时间状语 for over twenty years 表明用现在完成时被动语态 has been kept。

exercises.q: The problem ______ at the meeting yesterday, but no agreement was reached.
exercises.explain: 时间状语 yesterday 表明用一般过去时被动语态 was discussed。

exercises.q: The report ______ (must hand in) before Friday.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 must 后接 be + 过去分词构成被动语态，hand in 的过去分词为 handed in。

exercises.q: These old buildings ______ (pull down) next year to make room for a new park.
exercises.explain: 时间状语 next year 表明用一般将来时被动语态 will be pulled down。

exercises.q: The injured workers ______ (send) to the hospital immediately after the accident.
exercises.explain: 根据 after the accident 可知动作发生在过去，用一般过去时被动语态 were sent。

exercises.q: The sentence "The children are being taught English by Mr. Wang now." is in the present continuous passive voice.
exercises.explain: are being taught 是现在进行时被动语态，表示正在进行的被动动作。

exercises.q: The sentence "The book was written by Lu Xun." emphasizes the person who wrote the book.
exercises.explain: 被动语态强调的是动作的承受者 the book，而不是执行者 Lu Xun。

exercises.q: The workers are building a new bridge over the river. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: A new bridge is being built over the river by the workers.
exercises.explain: 现在进行时主动语态改为被动语态，结构为 is being built。

exercises.q: The homework must be finished before nine o'clock. (改为主动语态)

exercises.explain: 被动句中没有明确的执行者，主动语态可用 you 作主语，must 后接动词原形 finish。

exercises.q: They have planted thousands of trees in the past few years. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: Thousands of trees have been planted in the past few years.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时主动语态改为被动语态，结构为 have been planted。

exercises.q: The new computers are being installed by the engineers at the moment.
exercises.answer: The new computers are being installed by the engineers at the moment.
exercises.explain: 该句语法正确，are being installed 是现在进行时被动语态，无需修改。

exercises.q: The children is often told not to play near the river.
exercises.answer: The children are often told not to play near the river.
exercises.explain: 主语 The children 是复数，be 动词应用 are 而不是 is。

exercises.explain: 时间状语 around 300 AD 表明用一般过去时被动语态 was destroyed。

exercises.explain: until 引导的时间状语从句用现在完成时表示将来，主句用一般将来时被动语态 will not be announced。

exercises.q: The proposal ______ by the committee before it was submitted to the board for final approval.
exercises.explain: before 引导的从句用一般过去时，主句动作发生在从句之前，用过去完成时被动语态 had been reviewed。

exercises.q: The endangered species ______ under the protection of the new wildlife conservation law.
exercises.explain: 主语 The endangered species 是复数，一般现在时被动语态用 are placed。

exercises.q: The ancient temple ______ (restore) several times since it was first built in the Tang Dynasty.
exercises.explain: since 引导的时间状语从句表明用现在完成时被动语态 has been restored。

exercises.q: The safety regulations ______ (must observe) at all times within the factory premises.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 must 后接 be + 过去分词构成被动语态，observe 的过去分词为 observed。

exercises.q: The final decision ______ (expect) to be announced by the end of this week.
exercises.explain: 主语 The final decision 是单数，一般现在时被动语态用 is expected。

exercises.explain: is being questioned 是现在进行时被动语态，表示正在进行的被动动作。

grammar.titleEn: Comparative Adjectives: From -er/more to Modifiers and Senior-Level Usage
grammar.usage:
形容词比较级用于对两个人、事物、概念或状态进行程度上的对比，核心结构为“比较级 + than + 比较对象”。在初中阶段，学生主要掌握单音节和部分双音节形容词加-er（如 tall → taller, big → bigger, heavy → heavier）以及多音节形容词前加 more（如 beautiful → more beautiful），并用 than 引出被比较对象。进入高中阶段后，比较级的用法进一步拓展：一是比较级前可使用程度副词或短语进行修饰，如 much, far, a lot, even, still, a bit, a little, slightly, rather, no, any 等，以表达差异的大小或强调；二是比较级可出现在更复杂的句法结构中，如“the + 比较级, the + 比较级”（越……越……）、“比较级 + and + 比较级”（越来越……）、“the + 比较级 + of the two”（两者中较……的一个）；三是在书面语和正式语域中，比较级常与替代词 that/those 连用，避免重复名词，如 The climate here is milder than that of Beijing。

肯定句结构为“A + be/动词 + 比较级 + than + B”，否定句在 be/助动词后加 not，如“This train is not cheaper than that one.”。疑问句将 be/助动词提前，如“Is this train cheaper than that one?”。需要注意的是，比较级本身不直接构成否定，否定的是整个谓语部分。

与近义结构对比：比较级（comparative）用于两者之间的比较，而最高级（superlative）用于三者或三者以上的比较。此外，“as + 形容词原级 + as”表示“和……一样”，其否定形式“not as/so + 原级 + as”表示“不如……”，这与比较级在语义上有重叠，但语体不同——比较级更直接，as...as 结构更强调等同或差异的程度。高中阶段还需区分“more + 形容词”构成的比较级与“more + 名词”表示数量更多的用法，例如 more comfortable（更舒适的）与 more money（更多的钱）。

易错点方面：第一，不可同时使用 -er 和 more，如 more cheaper 是典型错误；第二，不规则形容词的比较级需单独记忆，如 good → better, bad → worse, far → farther/further, little → less, many/much → more；第三，以辅音字母加 y 结尾的形容词变比较级时，y 要变为 i 再加 -er（如 happy → happier），而以元音字母加 y 结尾的则直接加 -er（如 grey → greyer）；第四，重读闭音节且末尾只有一个辅音字母的形容词，需双写该辅音字母再加 -er（如 hot → hotter, thin → thinner, big → bigger）。
forms: 单音节/部分双音节形容词：adj. + -er + than + 比较对象（tall → taller than）
多音节/部分双音节形容词：more + adj. + than + 比较对象（more expensive than）
否定结构：A + be/助动词 + not + 比较级 + than + B（is not cheaper than）
疑问结构：Be/助动词 + A + 比较级 + than + B?（Is this train cheaper than that one?）
程度修饰：much / far / a lot / even / still / a bit / a little / slightly / rather + 比较级（much cheaper than）
特殊句型：the + 比较级, the + 比较级（The sooner, the better.）；比较级 + and + 比较级（better and better）
notes: 高考书面语中，比较级后替代不可数名词用 that，替代可数名词复数用 those，避免重复：The population of Shanghai is larger than that of Nanjing.
far 的比较级有 farther 和 further 两种形式：farther 多指具体距离“更远”，further 多指抽象程度“进一步”，高考阅读和写作中需根据语境区分。
比较级前用 much 或 far 表示“……得多”，用 a bit 或 a little 表示“稍微……一点”，但不可用 very 修饰比较级，very 只能修饰原级。
“the + 比较级, the + 比较级”结构中，两个分句均需用比较级，且 the 不可省略，这是高考语法填空和写作中的高频考点。
有些以 -or 结尾的形容词本身已是比较级含义（如 superior, inferior, senior, junior），后面接 to 而不是 than，如 be superior to（优于），这是高中书面语中的高级用法。

grammar.key: Modal Verb 'can' for Ability/Possibility / 情态动词'can'表能力/可能性
grammar.title: 情态动词 can 表能力与可能性（拓展 could / be able to / may / might）
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verb 'can' for Ability & Possibility (Extended: could / be able to / may / might)
grammar.usage:
情态动词 can 的核心结构为“can + 动词原形”，无人称和数的变化，后面不能接 to，也不能接动词的 -ing、-ed 等形式。肯定句用“主语 + can + 动词原形”，否定句用“主语 + cannot/can't + 动词原形”，疑问句把 can 提到主语之前，即“Can + 主语 + 动词原形？”。can 主要表达三类意义：能力、可能性、许可。本讲重点聚焦能力与可能性，并拓展到 could、be able to、may、might 等相关结构。

在初中阶段，can 多用于表达“会做某事”的能力，如 I can swim. 以及“可以”的许可，如 Can I go out? 高中阶段则更强调 can 在语境中的细微差别：can 表“理论上的可能性”时，常指一般情况或事物本身具备的性质，如 It can get very cold in winter. 而 may/might 表“具体事件的可能性”时，语气更弱、更不确定，如 He may come later. 此外，高中还要求掌握 could 作为 can 的过去式，以及 could 用于现在或将来表示更委婉、更不确定的语气。

can 与 be able to 的对比是高中重点。can 只有现在式和过去式 could，没有完成式、进行式或不定式形式，因此当需要表达“将来能够”“已经能够”“想要能够”等意义时，要用 be able to 的相应形式，如 will be able to、have been able to、want to be able to。在表达“过去某次具体做成某事”时，常用 was/were able to 或 managed to，而不用 could，因为 could 多表示过去的一般能力或可能性，不强调“成功做成”。

易错点一：can 后面误加 to，如 I can to swim 是错误的。易错点二：第三人称单数误加 -s，如 He cans swim 是错误的。易错点三：把 can 用于将来能力，如 I will can swim 是错误的，应改为 I will be able to swim。易错点四：在否定句中 can't 可表达强烈的否定推测，意为“不可能”，如 He can't be at home now. 此时语气比 may not/might not 更强。
forms: 肯定式：主语 + can + 动词原形
否定式：主语 + cannot / can't + 动词原形
疑问式：Can + 主语 + 动词原形？
过去式：主语 + could + 动词原形
将来能力：主语 + will be able to + 动词原形
委婉/不确定可能性：主语 + may / might / could + 动词原形
notes: can 无人称和数的变化，第三人称单数不加 -s，后面永远接动词原形。
高考书面语中，表达“过去某次成功做成某事”优先用 was/were able to 或 managed to，避免用 could。
can't 在否定推测中语气很强，意为“不可能”，比 may not / might not 更肯定，注意语域差异。
表达将来能力时不能用 will can，要用 will be able to，这是高考语法填空和改错的常考点。
could 既可作 can 的过去式，也可用于现在或将来表示更委婉、更不确定的语气，需根据语境判断。

examples.en: I can ride a bike.
examples.cn: 我会骑自行车。

examples.en: Can you help me with my homework?
examples.cn: 你能帮我做作业吗？

examples.en: It can be very hot in summer in my hometown.
examples.cn: 我家乡的夏天可能会非常热。

examples.en: She could read when she was four years old.
examples.cn: 她四岁时就能阅读了。

examples.en: We will be able to finish the project by Friday if everyone cooperates.
examples.cn: 如果大家合作，我们到周五就能完成这个项目。

examples.en: He can't have forgotten the meeting; he was reminded twice this morning.
examples.cn: 他不可能忘了会议，今天早上有人提醒了他两次。

exercises.q: My little brother ______ ride a bike now. He learned it last week.
exercises.explain: can 后面直接跟动词原形，且第三人称单数不加 s。

exercises.q: ______ you help me carry this box, please?
exercises.explain: 用 Can 开头表示请求许可或询问能力。

exercises.q: Birds ______ fly high in the sky.
exercises.explain: 表示一般能力时用 can，could 多用于过去或委婉语气。

exercises.q: She ______ speak English very well. She practices every day.
exercises.explain: 从后文每天练习可知她英语说得很好，用肯定 can。

exercises.q: It ______ be very cold in winter in Harbin.
exercises.explain: can 在这里表示可能性，意为"可能会"。

exercises.q: I ______ swim very fast. (用 can 的适当形式填空)
exercises.explain: 主语 I 后用 can 表示能力。

exercises.q: He ______ (not) play the piano. He never learned it.
exercises.explain: 否定形式用 can't 或 cannot，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: ______ you see the blackboard clearly from here?
exercises.explain: 疑问句将 can 提前，首字母大写。

exercises.q: He cans run very fast.
exercises.explain: can 是情态动词，第三人称单数不加 s。

exercises.q: They can't speak Chinese, but they can speak English.
exercises.explain: can't 和 can 后都接动词原形，句子结构正确。

exercises.q: I can play basketball. (改为否定句)
exercises.explain: 否定句在 can 后加 not，缩写为 can't。

exercises.q: She can dance well. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 can 提到主语前。

exercises.q: My father can cook. (改为否定句)
exercises.explain: 否定形式在 can 后加 not。

exercises.q: He can to swim very fast.
exercises.explain: can 后必须跟动词原形，不能带 to。

exercises.q: She cans speak Japanese.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 没有人称和数的变化。

exercises.q: When I was five, I ______ read simple stories by myself.
exercises.explain: 表示过去的能力用 could。

exercises.q: Don't worry. You ______ finish the work tomorrow.
exercises.explain: 表示将来的能力用 will be able to，不用 will can。

exercises.q: ______ I use your phone? Mine is out of battery.
exercises.explain: May I 用于礼貌地请求许可，比 Can I 更正式。

exercises.q: The light is on. He ______ be at home now.
exercises.explain: must 表示很有把握的肯定推测，意为"一定"。

exercises.q: She ______ be at the library because I just saw her in the classroom.
exercises.explain: can't 表示强烈的否定推测，意为"不可能"。

exercises.q: By the end of this year, I ______ (able) to drive a car.
exercises.explain: 表示将来获得的能力用 will be able to。

exercises.q: ______ you swim when you were seven years old?
exercises.explain: 询问过去的能力用 Could，首字母大写。

exercises.q: It ______ be true. I don't believe it at all.
exercises.explain: can't 表示强烈的不相信，意为"不可能是真的"。

exercises.q: He could speaks three languages when he was young.
exercises.explain: could 后必须跟动词原形 speak，不能加 s。

exercises.q: I will can help you with your homework tomorrow.
exercises.explain: can 没有将来式，应改为 will be able to。

exercises.q: She could play the violin when she was six. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: She couldn't play the violin when she was six.
exercises.explain: could 的否定形式是 couldn't，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: He can speak French. (用 be able to 改写)
exercises.answer: He is able to speak French.
exercises.explain: can 表能力时可与 be able to 互换，注意人称和时态。

exercises.q: They could finish the project on time. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Could they finish the project on time?
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 could 提到主语前。

exercises.q: She will can come to the party next week.
exercises.answer: She will be able to come to the party next week.
exercises.explain: can 不能与 will 连用，应改为 will be able to。

exercises.q: He could to swim across the river when he was young.
exercises.answer: He could swim across the river when he was young.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 could 后直接跟动词原形，不能带 to。

exercises.q: You can't imagine how marvellous it ______ be to cross a whole country by train.
exercises.explain: can 在此表示可能性，强调"可能会多么奇妙"。

exercises.q: Having studied hard for months, she ______ pass the exam easily.
exercises.explain: be able to 可用于各种时态，此处用一般现在时表能力。

exercises.q: The weather forecast says it ______ rain later, so take an umbrella.
exercises.explain: may 表示不确定的可能性，意为"可能会"。

exercises.q: He ______ have gone abroad, for his phone is always off and nobody has seen him for weeks.
exercises.explain: might have done 表示对过去情况的不确定推测。

exercises.q: Anyone ______ make a mistake, so we should learn to forgive.
exercises.explain: can 在此表示理论上的可能性，意为"任何人都可能"。

exercises.q: If you try your best, you ______ (able) to achieve your goal.
exercises.explain: 条件句主句用将来时，be able to 的将来形式为 will be able to。

exercises.q: He ______ have been at the meeting yesterday, because he was in hospital at that time.
exercises.explain: couldn't have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测，意为"不可能"。

exercises.q: With the help of the new technology, scientists ______ now predict earthquakes more accurately.
exercises.explain: can 表示现在具备的能力，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: He mustn't be at home now because his car is not in the driveway.
exercises.explain: 表示否定推测"不可能"应用 can't，而非 mustn't（表示禁止）。

exercises.q: She could have finished the task, but she chose not to.
exercises.explain: could have done 表示过去本有能力做但未做，结构正确。

exercises.q: It is possible that he is at home now. (用 can 改写)
exercises.answer: He can be at home now.
exercises.explain: can 可表示可能性，替代 It is possible that 结构。

exercises.q: She was able to solve the problem without any help. (用 could 改写)
exercises.answer: She could solve the problem without any help.
exercises.explain: 在肯定句中表示过去的一般能力，could 可替代 was able to。

exercises.q: I'm sure he isn't lying. (用 can't 改写)
exercises.explain: can't be doing 表示对正在进行的动作的否定推测。

exercises.q: He can have finished the work yesterday, but I'm not sure.
exercises.answer: He may have finished the work yesterday, but I'm not sure.
exercises.explain: 对过去情况的不确定推测用 may/might have done，can have done 不用于肯定推测。

exercises.q: She mustn't have seen the message because she hasn't replied yet.
exercises.answer: She can't have seen the message because she hasn't replied yet.
exercises.explain: 对过去的否定推测用 can't have done，mustn't have done 不用于推测。

exercises.q: My little brother ______ ride a bike when he was only four years old.
exercises.explain: 表示过去的能力要用 could，而不是 can。

exercises.q: ______ you help me carry this heavy box, please?
exercises.explain: Can 用于请求帮助，语气直接且常见。

exercises.q: She ______ speak French very well. She has lived in Paris for ten years.
exercises.explain: 表示现在具备的能力用 can。

exercises.q: It ______ be very cold in the mountains at night, so take a warm coat.
exercises.explain: can 表示客观可能性，意为“可能会”。

exercises.q: I ______ find my keys anywhere. Have you seen them?
exercises.explain: can't 表示现在没有能力做到某事。

exercises.q: Birds ______ fly, but dogs cannot.
exercises.explain: 表示动物的自然能力用 can。

exercises.q: ______ you swim when you were seven years old?
exercises.explain: 询问过去的能力用 Could。

exercises.q: He ______ play the piano at all. He has never learned it.
exercises.explain: can't 表示完全不具备某种能力。

exercises.q: The sentence "She cans speak English very well." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: can 是情态动词，第三人称单数不加 s。

exercises.q: The sentence "I can to swim very fast." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: can 后面必须跟动词原形，不能带 to。

exercises.q: She can speak Japanese. (改为否定句)
exercises.explain: can 的否定形式是 cannot 或 can't。

exercises.q: He can play basketball. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 提前构成一般疑问句。

exercises.q: I am able to finish the work today. (用 can 改写)
exercises.answer: I can finish the work today.
exercises.explain: be able to 表示能力时可与 can 互换。

exercises.q: My father can speaks three languages.
exercises.answer: My father can speak three languages.
exercises.explain: can 后面必须用动词原形 speak，不能用 speaks。

exercises.q: Do you can come to my party tomorrow?
exercises.answer: Can you come to my party tomorrow?
exercises.explain: can 作情态动词，疑问句直接提前，不需要助动词 do。

exercises.q: By the time she was ten, she ______ already read simple novels in English.
exercises.explain: 表示过去已经具备的能力用 could。

exercises.q: You ______ be right, but I still think we should check the data again.
exercises.explain: could 表示可能性，语气比 can 更弱、更委婉。

exercises.q: ______ I use your phone for a moment? Mine is out of battery.
exercises.explain: Can 用于请求许可，是日常口语中的常见用法。

exercises.q: The road is closed, so we ______ go through the city center.
exercises.explain: can't 表示由于客观条件限制而不可能做到。

exercises.q: If you practice regularly, you ______ improve your spoken English quickly.
exercises.explain: can 表示在某种条件下具备的可能性。

exercises.q: When I was a child, I ______ climb trees very quickly.
exercises.explain: 表示过去的能力用 could。

exercises.q: Don't worry. Anyone ______ make a mistake when learning a new language.
exercises.explain: can 表示普遍存在的可能性。

exercises.q: I'm afraid I ______ attend the meeting tomorrow because I have another appointment.
exercises.explain: can't 表示因客观原因无法做某事。

exercises.q: The sentence "He could speak English fluently when he was young." means he had the ability to speak English fluently in the past.
exercises.explain: could 表示过去具备的能力。

exercises.q: The sentence "It can be dangerous to drive fast in heavy rain." expresses permission.
exercises.explain: 这里的 can 表示可能性，而非许可。

exercises.q: It is possible for the weather to change suddenly in the mountains. (用 can 改写)
exercises.answer: The weather can change suddenly in the mountains.
exercises.explain: can 可用来表达客观可能性。

exercises.q: She was able to solve the problem by herself. (用 could 改写)
exercises.answer: She could solve the problem by herself.
exercises.explain: 表示过去的能力时 could 与 was able to 可互换。

exercises.q: Is it possible for me to leave early today? (用 Can 改写)
exercises.explain: Can 用于请求许可，相当于 Is it possible for me to...。

exercises.q: She could speaks three languages when she was in high school.
exercises.answer: She could speak three languages when she was in high school.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 could 后必须跟动词原形 speak。

exercises.q: Will you can come to the concert next week?
exercises.answer: Will you be able to come to the concert next week?
exercises.explain: 表示将来的能力通常用 will be able to，不用 will can。

exercises.q: Having lived in London for over a decade, she ______ understand the local accent without any difficulty.
exercises.explain: 表示现在具备的能力用 can，且与前面的现在分词短语时态一致。

exercises.q: The experiment results ______ be interpreted in several different ways, which is why further research is needed.
exercises.explain: can 表示某事存在多种可能性。

exercises.q: ______ it be that the ancient builders used simple tools to construct such a massive structure?
exercises.explain: Can 用于疑问句表示对可能性的推测或质疑。

exercises.q: Given the complexity of the task, I doubt whether he ______ complete it without any assistance.
exercises.explain: doubt whether 后的从句用 can 表示现在或将来的能力。

exercises.q: No matter how hard you try, you ______ always please everyone.
exercises.explain: can't 表示不可能做到某事，常用于否定判断。

exercises.q: With the rapid development of AI, machines ______ now perform tasks that were once thought to require human intelligence.
exercises.explain: can 表示现在具备的能力，强调技术发展的结果。

exercises.q: The witness's account ______ not be verified, as there were no other people present at the scene.
exercises.explain: could not 表示过去无法做到某事，语气比 can't 更弱。

exercises.q: Under no circumstances ______ the safety regulations be ignored in the laboratory.
exercises.explain: 倒装结构中 can 置于主语之前，表示强烈的否定可能性。

exercises.q: In the sentence "You can't be serious about quitting your job," the word "can't" expresses strong disbelief.
exercises.explain: can't 在否定句中常表示强烈的不相信。

exercises.q: The sentence "He can have finished the project by now" is grammatically correct when expressing possibility about the past.
exercises.explain: 对过去的推测应用 could have done 或 may have done，不能用 can have done。

exercises.q: It is possible that the ancient city was destroyed by an earthquake. (用 could 改写)
exercises.answer: The ancient city could have been destroyed by an earthquake.
exercises.explain: could have done 表示对过去可能性的推测。

exercises.q: I am unable to understand why he made such a decision. (用 cannot 改写)
exercises.answer: I cannot understand why he made such a decision.
exercises.explain: be unable to 与 cannot 都表示没有能力做某事。

exercises.q: Is there any possibility that the meeting will be postponed? (用 Can 改写)
exercises.explain: Can 用于询问可能性，相当于 Is there any possibility...。

exercises.q: The theory suggests that the universe can have begun with a massive explosion.
exercises.answer: The theory suggests that the universe could have begun with a massive explosion.
exercises.explain: 对过去事件的推测用 could have done，而非 can have done。

exercises.q: Despite the heavy rain, the rescue team could to reach the stranded climbers before nightfall.
exercises.answer: Despite the heavy rain, the rescue team could reach the stranded climbers before nightfall.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 could 后必须直接跟动词原形，不能带 to。

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: 动名词作主语：从基础到拓展（含不定式对比、形式主语与书面语表达）
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Subject: Core Usage and Extended Patterns
grammar.usage:
动名词是动词的 -ing 形式，在句中起名词作用。当动名词或动名词短语作主语时，表示一种泛指的活动、习惯、事实或抽象概念，而不是某一次具体动作。核心结构为“动名词短语 + 单数谓语动词”，因为动名词作主语时整体被视为单数概念。例如：Reading before bed helps me relax.（睡前阅读帮助我放松。）

肯定句直接以动名词短语开头，后接单数谓语；否定形式在动名词前加 not，例如：Not getting enough sleep affects your health.（睡眠不足会影响健康。）疑问形式通常借助形式主语 it 或使用一般疑问句结构，如：Does swimming help you stay fit?（游泳有助于保持健康吗？）在书面语中，也常见“It is + 形容词/名词 + 动名词短语”的结构，如：It is no use crying over spilled milk.（覆水难收。）

动名词作主语与不定式作主语有重要区别。动名词多表示普遍、习惯性、已知或正在进行的活动；不定式多表示具体的、将来的或一次性的动作。例如：Swimming is my favorite sport.（泛指游泳这项运动）与 To swim in that cold river is dangerous.（特指在那条冷河里游泳这件事）。高中阶段需要进一步掌握：某些形容词或名词后习惯用动名词作真正主语，如 no use, no good, worth, fun, a waste of time 等；同时要能识别动名词作主语与现在分词作表语或定语的区别。

初中阶段主要要求掌握动名词作主语的常见表达，如“Playing basketball is fun.”，并记住谓语用单数。高中阶段则要求：1）能区分动名词与不定式作主语的语用差异；2）掌握形式主语 it 的句型转换；3）在书面表达中恰当使用动名词短语作主语来提升句式多样性；4）理解动名词的复合结构作主语，如：His coming late made the teacher angry.（他迟到让老师生气。）

易错点一：动名词作主语时，谓语动词必须用单数，即使动名词短语中包含复数名词。例如：Reading books is important.（读书很重要。）不能说 Reading books are important. 易错点二：不要把进行时态中的现在分词误认为动名词作主语。例如：He is swimming in the pool.（他正在游泳池里游泳。）这里的 swimming 是现在分词，与 is 构成进行时，不是主语。易错点三：动名词的否定形式是 not 放在动名词前面，而不是后面。例如：Not telling the truth is wrong.（不说真话是错误的。）易错点四：在“It is no use/no good + 动名词”结构中，不要用不定式替代动名词。例如：It is no use complaining.（抱怨没有用。）不宜说 It is no use to complain.
forms: 动名词短语 + 单数谓语动词：Swimming is good exercise.
否定形式：Not + 动名词短语 + 单数谓语动词：Not exercising regularly leads to health problems.
疑问形式：Does + 动名词短语 + 谓语动词原形...?：Does reading in dim light hurt your eyes?
形式主语结构：It is + 形容词/名词 + 动名词短语：It is no use arguing with him.
动名词复合结构作主语：名词所有格/形容词性物主代词 + 动名词短语 + 单数谓语：His arriving late surprised everyone.
动名词作主语与不定式作主语对比：Swimming is fun.（泛指） vs To swim in this river is dangerous.（特指）
notes: 动名词作主语时，谓语动词永远用单数，即使动名词短语中包含复数名词。高考语法填空和短文改错常在此设空。
书面语中，动名词作主语比不定式作主语更常见、更自然。高考写作中适当使用动名词短语开头可提升句式多样性。
注意区分动名词作主语和现在分词作表语/定语。例如：The news is exciting.（现在分词作表语）与 Exciting news is always welcome.（动名词短语作主语，但此处 exciting 是形容词，注意不要混淆词性。）
在“It is no use/no good/worth + 动名词”结构中，动名词不可替换为不定式。这是高考语法填空的高频考点。
动名词的否定形式是 not 放在动名词前，不是放在谓语动词前。例如：Not knowing the answer is not a shame.（不知道答案并不丢人。）
